epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女王去度假,留給國王很多職務。他立即採取行動,找其他人來做。莉塔肯幫助國王……如果她能成為啫堡的女王!起初,所有孩子都很高興自己有份負責。不過,很快樂趣和遊戲就被只有莉塔開心的遊戲所取代。小女王必須意識到這種權力是如何沖昏她的頭腦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen goes on vacation, leaving King with lots of responsibilities. He leaps into action, finding someone else to do it. Rita will help the King...if she’s made Queen of Jammbo! At first, all the kids are happy one of their own is in charge. But,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們圍坐在篝火旁講恐怖故事。姑毛講述了最可怕的怪物故事,然後去吃點心。不過,他走得太遠!其他人必須在黑暗的樹林裡尋找他!神秘的影子和聲音很快讓他們都以為有怪物在跟蹤他們!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are sitting around a campfire telling scary stories. Goomo tells the scariest monster story and then goes off to get a snack. But, he’s gone too long! The others must look for him in the dark woods! Before long mysterious shadow and sounds h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫喱星頌揚音樂、樂趣和友誼。加入貝洛和他的朋友們的喜劇冒險之旅,學習在神奇的詹博星球(宇宙音樂的起源)上和諧相處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello makes a mistake and decides to make up a story, which is hard to believe. Mina gets angry and will put him to the test: the Candy of Truth. A sweet that makes you float every time you lie. Bello accepts the challenge and a spiral of lies and da

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜嘗試打造啫堡史上最驚人的韆鞦來取悅國王。不幸的是,這位年輕的科學家很快就發現,無論多麼先進的技術,都無法取締團隊合作和友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路被委派一項非常重要的工作—負責管理音樂工廠!儘管女王留下了說明書,比路卻無視它。她一去休息,整個運作就變得瘋狂。可憐的渡渡鳥努力把事情做好,但欠缺知情的老闆,災難迫在眉睫。比路必須快速學習,準備工作是正確執行任何工作的關鍵!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. As soon as she goes off for a much needed rest, the whole operation goes way crazy. The poor dodo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔厭倦了她玩的每場比賽都輸掉,所以她用一些小氣的手鐲來助她必勝。儘管一開始她很開心,但卻發現自己掉進一個危險的陷阱,並將使她成為一個失敗者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita is tired of losing at every game she plays so she allies herself with some stingy bracelets that will help her win at absolutely everything. Even though she is happy at first, Rita discovers that she’s fallen into a dangerous trap, which will ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡有麻煩了!它那奇妙的音樂泡泡充滿了垃圾和黏糊糊的東西。經過調查整個星球,國王、王后和孩子們意識到泡泡裡的垃圾正是他們的垃圾!他們齊心協力改變邋遢的習慣,讓啫堡恢復啫喱般的健康。他們在過程中將垃圾回收成大家都能享用的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多得一些突破性的科學,米娜能夠讓物體和她自己隱形!她看到隱形對她信任的朋友的影響!經過一天的瘋狂事件後,孩子們發現了所有看不見的怪事的罪魁禍首。他們想出一個自己的實驗,看看科學家有多喜歡接受測試!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisib

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡從未經歷過最驚人的事件之一即將發生。姑毛不想錯過它。這就是為何他嘗試向他的朋友隱瞞他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有無法掩飾的症狀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most amazing events that Jammbo has ever experienced is about to occur. And Goomo doesn’t want tomiss it. That’s why he tries to hide his Jelly-Measles from his friends. Unfortunately, the measles have symptoms that are impossible to disgu

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 受到閃電和雷聲的驚嚇,比路和姑毛在音樂工廠尋求庇護。不過進去以後,他們才意識到將迎接更可怕的事;城堡裡有個幽靈嚇壞了渡渡鳥,阻止牠們製造音樂泡泡!如果渡渡鳥停下來,啫堡就沒有音樂。而如果沒有音樂,啫喱星就會凍結!哎呀!男孩們需要找到幽靈,擊潰它並拯救永遠充滿音樂氣息的啫堡!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們擺放了一些不屬於海帶森林的海星/ 孩子們認識火山。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids put some Asterina sea star in the Kelp Forest where they don’t belong / The kids learn about volcanoes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花邀請阿波、阿燈和泡寶參加礁鎮游俠的探險之旅 / 水花和牠的朋友們遇到一隻年輕的海龜史豁。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash invites Ripple, Bubbles, and Dunk on a Reeftown Rangers exploration adventure / Splash and his friends meet Scoot, a young sea turtle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們驚訝地發現曾經茂盛的珊瑚礁現已變得一片荒蕪/ 水花和牠的朋友們結束旅程,返回礁鎮的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are surprised to find a once lush reef is now a ghost reef / Splash and his friends end their journey, returning home to Reeftown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們尋寶/ 泡寶很在意臉上正癒合的疤痕。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids hunt for treasure / Bubbles feels self-conscious about a healing blemish on her face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利因故必須取代遠東節的星級表演者。但他真的很緊張。孩子們將如何幫助比利,成為他也從未想過能成為的明星呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Something happens and Billy has to take over as the star performer of the Far East Festival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個有趣的露營之夜變得恐怖。叢林裡真的有鬼嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fun night of camping turns spooky. Are there real ghosts in the jungle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 玲媽媽開展一項新的送餐服務,但諸事不順,連帶她的評分也下降。孩子們會怎樣幫助玲媽媽改善生意?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mama Ling starts a new food delivery service, but it doesnt go well and her rating drops.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寶拉為阿米爾王子做了一頂新帽子。但改變王子的裝束會令沙漠出現一些不良後果。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Paula makes a new hat for Prince Aamil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當莫里士和紅鬍子角色互換後會有何結果?莫里士會成為比紅鬍子更厲害的海盜船長嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What happens when Maurice and Redbeard switch roles? Will Maurice be a better pirate captain than Redbeard?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添和阿米爾王子交換了一天的崗位。兩個男孩在一天易地而處時學到甚麼?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim and Prince Aamil swap places for a day!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿米爾王子邀請孩子們到皇宮過夜。沒有人願意浪費一夜的時間去睡覺。孩子們計劃各種有趣的活動來保持清醒,同時要避免被警衛先生抓住。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prince Aamil invites the children over to the Palace for a sleepover.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幻想你因看起來與眾不同而成為異類。這就是沒有鼻子的斯芬克斯叔叔的感覺。孩子們打算給他造一個適合的鼻子,但事情不像斯芬克斯叔叔預期。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Imagine being the odd one out because you look different. Thats how Uncle Sphinx felt without a nose.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠把食蟹獼猴放生到野外。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers return a crab eating macaque to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠把江獺嬰兒帶回雨林的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers take a baby smooth coated otter home to the rainforest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去印尼的蘇門答臘尋找小猩猩的媽媽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers travel to the Indonesian island of Sumatra to search for a baby orangutans mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去到森林讓害羞的穿山甲跟媽媽團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers make a trip to the jungle to reunite a shy pangolin with its mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 英雄找到一顆孵出科莫多巨蜥的蛋。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hero finds an egg from which hatches a komodo dragon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去澳洲幫樹熊找一個家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers head to Australia to find a home for a koala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場捉迷藏遊戲發現了一頭蘇門答臘犀牛的嬰兒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A game of hide and seek results in the discovery of a baby Sumatran rhinoceros!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠帶著一隻年青的大熊貓到中國找竹林。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers take a young giant panda to China to search for a bamboo forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物如何應付高溫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about how animals deal with the heat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集講述的是動物可以做的奇妙的事情!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the wonderful fantastic things that animals can do!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集中,我們踏上了前往大南方土地(也稱為澳洲)的旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we embark on a journey to the Great Southern Land – also known as Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這一集中,我們來看看移動非常慢的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we look at animals that move really slowwwwww.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 耳朵真的很有用—它們幫助我們聽到並阻止我們的太陽眼鏡掉下來!但是有些動物的耳朵更大更聰明!這就是為何今集的測驗全都關於擁有特別耳朵的動物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about animals with exceptional ears.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 把燈關掉,準備嚇一跳,因為今集的測驗集合了怪物般的動物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is a mash up of monster animals!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於奇怪野生動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about wild and weird animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於濕漉漉野生動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about wet and wild animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小麻在聽完關於騎士保護一朵神秘玫瑰的床邊故事後,嘗試阻止蛛華士採摘陽光派中最美麗的花朵。/陽光派裡有寶藏!一個廢棄的蜂巢。每隻昆蟲翻箱倒籠尋寶,當中包括史角和蹦士。不過,當他們遇到被困在松樹汁中,即將變成化石的蛛華士時,孩子們必須放棄黃金寶藏夢去幫助一隻需要幫助的昆蟲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hearing a bedtime story about Knights protecting a mythical Rose, Shimmer tries to prevent Spiderus from picking the most beautiful flower in Sunny Patch./ There is treasure in Sunny Patch! An abandoned honeycomb. Every bug is looking high and

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是陽光派的開心活日——這天你要向身邊蟲散播關心——小龍同時學到分享的重要性。/蜘蛛小姐為孩子們建造一個俱樂部,因小龍過於沉迷於讓它成為陽光派最特別的俱樂部,結果他成了唯一的會員。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s Heartwood Day in Sunny Patch -- a day to show the bugs around you how much you care./ When Miss Spider builds the kids a clubhouse, Dragon gets so carried away making it the most special club in Sunny Patch, he winds up its only member.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛發現了一個嘈雜的重金屬搖滾音樂盒,他認為這很棒,但卻令啫堡的其他人都抓狂。必須做點甚麼!比路和米娜騙了姑毛並用魔術讓盒子「消失」。沒有了他的「勁爆音樂」盒子,姑毛十分苦惱。比路和米娜意識到音樂對姑毛有多重要,並讓盒子重新出現。姑毛在過程中意識到即使他們不喜歡他的音樂也沒關係,他有很多音樂盒可以滿
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo’s discovers a noisy Heavy Metal Rock music box which he thinks is awesome but drives everyone elso on Jammbo crazy. Something must be done! Bello and Mina fool Goomo with a magic trick that makes the box “disappear”.Without his Wamma Jamma bo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由於國王的奇怪睡眠習慣,女王把他趕出了城堡。被黑影和不尋常的聲音所籠罩,國王立即到比路的房子尋求庇護,但他們離睡個好覺還很遠。經過一系列奇怪的睡前儀式,比路終於明白問題所在,並幫助國王克服對夜晚的恐懼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Due to King’s weird sleep habits, Queen kicks him out of the castle. Surrounded by dark shadows and unusual sounds, King quickly seeks refuge at Bello’s house, but they are a long way from a good night’s sleep.After a series of strange bedtime ritual

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛在啫喱莓樹林裡睡著了。國王在附近嘗試用一台異常強大的機器打開他的汽水瓶,這台機器最終撞倒了啫喱樹!姑毛在廢墟中驚恐地醒來!他說服自己是罪魁禍首!比路和米娜收集線索,讓國王為自己的行為負責,並讓姑毛認清事實。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo falls asleep in the jellyberry grove.Nearby, King tries to open his soda bottle with a ridiculously powerful machine that ends up knocking over the jellyberry trees! Goomo wakes among the ruins horrified! He convinces himself that he is to blam

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜發明了一個巨型機器人來給啫堡換燈泡。比路認為機械人應該用來保護啫堡免受入侵者的侵擾!在米娜不知情的情況下,他修改了「啫堡機械人」的程式,導致它發生故障,並大肆破壞啫喱星。比路明白了「別碰我的東西!」這句話背後的含義。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina invents a giant robot for changing light bulbs on Jammbo. Bello thinks the robot should be made to defend Jammbo from invaders! Without Mina’s knowledge, he modifies “Jammbobot” causing it to malfunction and rampage through the planet. Bello dis

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇家花園中的女王之歌果實被盜。偵探二人組啫堡俠和拍檔俠需要破案。每個人都是疑犯。他們的聆聽技巧和團隊合作幫助他們抓住水果賊。這真是一個驚喜—即使對小偷亦然。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen’s Song Fruit are being stolen from the royal garden.It’s up to the detective duo of Jammboman and Sidekickman to solve this crime. Everyone is a suspect. Their listening skills and teamwork help them catch the fruit filcher. It’s quite a su

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路被委派一項非常重要的工作—負責管理音樂工廠!儘管女王留下了說明書,比路卻無視它。她一去休息,整個運作就變得瘋狂。可憐的渡渡鳥努力把事情做好,但欠缺知情的老闆,災難迫在眉睫。比路必須快速學習,準備工作是正確執行任何工作的關鍵!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. As soon as she goes off for a much needed rest, the whole operation goes way crazy. The poor dodo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔厭倦了她玩的每場比賽都輸掉,所以她用一些小氣的手鐲來助她必勝。儘管一開始她很開心,但卻發現自己掉進一個危險的陷阱,並將使她成為一個失敗者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita is tired of losing at every game she plays so she allies herself with some stingy bracelets that will help her win at absolutely everything. Even though she is happy at first, Rita discovers that she’s fallen into a dangerous trap, which will ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡有麻煩了!它那奇妙的音樂泡泡充滿了垃圾和黏糊糊的東西。經過調查整個星球,國王、王后和孩子們意識到泡泡裡的垃圾正是他們的垃圾!他們齊心協力改變邋遢的習慣,讓啫堡恢復啫喱般的健康。他們在過程中將垃圾回收成大家都能享用的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多得一些突破性的科學,米娜能夠讓物體和她自己隱形!她看到隱形對她信任的朋友的影響!經過一天的瘋狂事件後,孩子們發現了所有看不見的怪事的罪魁禍首。他們想出一個自己的實驗,看看科學家有多喜歡接受測試!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisib

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡從未經歷過最驚人的事件之一即將發生。姑毛不想錯過它。這就是為何他嘗試向他的朋友隱瞞他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有無法掩飾的症狀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most amazing events that Jammbo has ever experienced is about to occur. And Goomo doesn’t want tomiss it. That’s why he tries to hide his Jelly-Measles from his friends. Unfortunately, the measles have symptoms that are impossible to disgu

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 受到閃電和雷聲的驚嚇,比路和姑毛在音樂工廠尋求庇護。不過進去以後,他們才意識到將迎接更可怕的事;城堡裡有個幽靈嚇壞了渡渡鳥,阻止牠們製造音樂泡泡!如果渡渡鳥停下來,啫堡就沒有音樂。而如果沒有音樂,啫喱星就會凍結!哎呀!男孩們需要找到幽靈,擊潰它並拯救永遠充滿音樂氣息的啫堡!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小麻在聽完關於騎士保護一朵神秘玫瑰的床邊故事後,嘗試阻止蛛華士採摘陽光派中最美麗的花朵。/陽光派裡有寶藏!一個廢棄的蜂巢。每隻昆蟲翻箱倒籠尋寶,當中包括史角和蹦士。不過,當他們遇到被困在松樹汁中,即將變成化石的蛛華士時,孩子們必須放棄黃金寶藏夢去幫助一隻需要幫助的昆蟲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hearing a bedtime story about Knights protecting a mythical Rose, Shimmer tries to prevent Spiderus from picking the most beautiful flower in Sunny Patch./ There is treasure in Sunny Patch! An abandoned honeycomb. Every bug is looking high and

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是陽光派的開心活日——這天你要向身邊蟲散播關心——小龍同時學到分享的重要性。/蜘蛛小姐為孩子們建造一個俱樂部,因小龍過於沉迷於讓它成為陽光派最特別的俱樂部,結果他成了唯一的會員。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s Heartwood Day in Sunny Patch -- a day to show the bugs around you how much you care./ When Miss Spider builds the kids a clubhouse, Dragon gets so carried away making it the most special club in Sunny Patch, he winds up its only member.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠把食蟹獼猴放生到野外。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers return a crab eating macaque to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠把江獺嬰兒帶回雨林的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers take a baby smooth coated otter home to the rainforest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去印尼的蘇門答臘尋找小猩猩的媽媽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers travel to the Indonesian island of Sumatra to search for a baby orangutans mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去到森林讓害羞的穿山甲跟媽媽團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers make a trip to the jungle to reunite a shy pangolin with its mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 英雄找到一顆孵出科莫多巨蜥的蛋。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hero finds an egg from which hatches a komodo dragon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去澳洲幫樹熊找一個家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers head to Australia to find a home for a koala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場捉迷藏遊戲發現了一頭蘇門答臘犀牛的嬰兒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A game of hide and seek results in the discovery of a baby Sumatran rhinoceros!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠帶著一隻年青的大熊貓到中國找竹林。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers take a young giant panda to China to search for a bamboo forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們擺放了一些不屬於海帶森林的海星/ 孩子們認識火山。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids put some Asterina sea star in the Kelp Forest where they don’t belong / The kids learn about volcanoes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花邀請阿波、阿燈和泡寶參加礁鎮游俠的探險之旅 / 水花和牠的朋友們遇到一隻年輕的海龜史豁。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash invites Ripple, Bubbles, and Dunk on a Reeftown Rangers exploration adventure / Splash and his friends meet Scoot, a young sea turtle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們驚訝地發現曾經茂盛的珊瑚礁現已變得一片荒蕪/ 水花和牠的朋友們結束旅程,返回礁鎮的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are surprised to find a once lush reef is now a ghost reef / Splash and his friends end their journey, returning home to Reeftown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們尋寶/ 泡寶很在意臉上正癒合的疤痕。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids hunt for treasure / Bubbles feels self-conscious about a healing blemish on her face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集中,我們將了解什麼是反芻動物。從牛到羊和沼澤鹿。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we discover what a ruminant is. From cows to sheep and marsh deer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物的清潔習慣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the cleaning habits of animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物王國裡充滿了不同種類的帶翅膀的生物——這一集是關於它們的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The animal kingdom is filled with different kinds of winged creatures – and this episode is all about them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集被稱為“顛倒的”,這是一個奇怪的奇特節目,一切都不像你想像的那樣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is called ‘Topsy Turvy’ it’s a weird peculiar show where nothing is quite as you would think.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於動物巨無霸的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about really big animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於捲尾動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about twisted animal tails.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於超鮮豔動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about crazy coloured animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於吵鬧的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about noisy animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王不想與人分享他的新火箭驅動滑板,所以把它藏在一個魔法盒子裡。姑毛和比路決定取得它,挑戰國王的意願,最終進入一個更大的新世界。一個充滿樂趣和……危險的世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇后心情不好。國王和孩子們同意舉辦有史以來最好的生日派對。不幸的是,每個參與者對於如何組織女王的驚喜派對都有個別非常特別的想法。它的成功將取決於他們「易地而處」的能力。尤其是女王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen feels gloomy. The King and the children agree to organize the best birthday party ever. Unfortunately each of the participants has a very particular idea as to how to organize the Queen’s surprise party. Its success will depend on their cap

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路厭倦了女王,他認為女王試圖毀掉他所有的冒險和遊戲。在滿天流星的星夜,比路許下一個願望:願女王變回少女,讓他為所欲為。當比路的願望成真,他將必須當個瘋狂的小女王哥哥,並意識到這可能是很艱鉅的任務,有時甚至很危險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is fed up with the Queen, whom he thinks tries to ruin all his adventures and games. On a starry night, full of shooting stars, Bello makes a wish: may the Queen become a young girl again so she can let him do anything he wants. When Bello’s wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒來發現珍愛的頭盔不見了!最重要的是,他的朋友們表現得很奇怪,他們似乎都忘記了他的生日。姑毛很樂意讓一切恢復正常。幸運的是,他收到一個驚喜,可以讓這天成為一個非常特別的日子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its Goomos birthday and his hopes are high. Unfortunately, he wakes to find his precious helmet missing! On top of that his friends are acting strangely and they all appear to have forgotten all about his birthday. Goomo would be happy to have thin

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安高在與比路和姑毛玩耍時弄傷了自己,因此必須在家休息幾天。比路感到內疚,決定搬進安高的房子,直到他的朋友好轉為止。他們對生活的不同看法相交,然後一起發現如果睜大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的細節,也可以很享受。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ongo hurt himself while playing with Bello and Goomo so he must stay at home to rest for several days. Bello feels guilty and decides to move into Ongo’s house until his friend feels better. Their different views on life will meet and together they’l

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔在米娜的實驗室試做自己的實驗。她很快就發現首先需要學習一些基礎知識來避免災難發生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita tries her own experiments in Mina’s lab. She’ll soon discover she first needs to learn some basics in order to avoid a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #17
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎一位非常特別的嘉賓積克自己來到節目。不過積克卻興奮得忘了邀請另一位嘉賓。牠們趕得及嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a very special guest Jake to the show. In all the excitement, however, Jake forgot to invite another guest. Will they find someone in time?

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #18
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #18
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎海狸和蜘蛛來到節目。牠們都很特別,會自製家園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Beaver and a Spider to the show. Both of these animals are special because they make their own homes.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #19
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎狼和狒狒來到節目。牠們都喜歡聯群結隊出行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Wolf and a Baboon to the show. These animals like to hang out and travel in groups.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #20
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎袋鼠和青蛙來到節目。牠們都因跳來跳去而享負盛名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Kangaroo and a Frog to the show.  Both of these animals are known for hopping around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是叢林小子的生日!孩子們和他們的叢林朋友計劃一場驚喜派對,但他們無法向叢林男孩保守秘密。 驚喜生日派對會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its Jungle Boys birthday! The children and their jungle friends plan a surprise party, but they have trouble keeping it a secret from Jungle Boy. Will the surprise birthday party be a success?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添和比利在叢林參加賽車比賽。寶拉幫他倆訓練。不過,阿添自信無需任何訓練都能擊敗比利。到底誰會贏出比賽?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim and Billy compete in a jungle car race. Paula helps both of them train. However, Tim is confident hell be able to beat Billy without any training. Who will win the race?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們幫紅鬍子船長找回他的摯友鸚鵡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children help Captain Redbeard to get back his best friend, Parrot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 所有人都擁有很酷的超能力,除了比利。驚奇超人組前往叢林拯救世界。比利能為任務有所貢獻嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone has a cool superpower, except Billy. Action Team Awesome goes to the Jungle to save the day. Will Billy be able to contribute to the missions?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 吐比跌得很傷,他的兄弟感到自責。他們開始待吐比很好以作補償。不過,如果吐比對兄弟隱瞞了一個秘密又會怎樣呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Toby has a terrible fall and his brothers feel responsible. They start being very nice to Toby to make up for it. But what if Toby is hiding a secret from his brothers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遠東村角逐「有史以來最佳村莊」獎。他們的確很大機會獲勝,除了一個小問題……實際上是兩個。這兩位村民可以改善自己,還是令整條村輸掉比賽?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Far East Village is up for the Best Village Ever Award. Theyve got a real chance of winning, except for one tiny problem...well 2 actually. Can these 2 villagers improve themselves, or cause the entire village to lose?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們初次去外太空旅行並見到太空人先生的女兒。阿添對女孩的固有印象受到衝擊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children travel to Outer Space to meet Mr. Astronauts daughter for the first time. Tims perception of what girls are like is challenged.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿斯池特養了一隻新小狗。孩子們幫她訓練小狗,以參加這個世界以外的狗展比賽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children help Astrid train her puppy for a dog show competition that is out of this world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧、姬蒂、英雄和一隻馬來熊幼兒到雨林找牠的媽媽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo, Katie, Hero and a sun bear cub set off for the rainforest to find the cubs mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠為了幫荷馬嬰兒找到一個家而踏上旅途。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers hit the road to help get a baby hippopotamus home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧和英雄在花園遊玩時找到一條網紋蟒和牠的蛋。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While playing in the garden, Leo and Hero find a reticulated python and its eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姬蒂認出在花園發現的大嘴鳥是澳洲鵜鶘。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Katie identifies a large beaked bird in the garden as an Australian pelican.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠的任務是讓走失的馬來獏跟牠的媽媽團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers are on a quest to reunite a lost Malayan tapir with its mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠在日落後找出長舌果蝠的巢穴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers embark on a search after sundown to find a dawn bats cave.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠出發把一隻迷路的緞藍園丁鳥帶回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers set out to take a lost satin bowerbird home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠的任務是把白腹黑啄木鳥帶回雨林的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers are on a mission to return a white bellied woodpecker home to the rainforest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集中,我們將了解什麼是反芻動物。從牛到羊和沼澤鹿。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we discover what a ruminant is. From cows to sheep and marsh deer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物的清潔習慣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the cleaning habits of animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物王國裡充滿了不同種類的帶翅膀的生物——這一集是關於它們的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The animal kingdom is filled with different kinds of winged creatures – and this episode is all about them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集被稱為“顛倒的”,這是一個奇怪的奇特節目,一切都不像你想像的那樣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is called ‘Topsy Turvy’ it’s a weird peculiar show where nothing is quite as you would think.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於動物巨無霸的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about really big animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於捲尾動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about twisted animal tails.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於超鮮豔動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about crazy coloured animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於吵鬧的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about noisy animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史角兩個長翅膀的兄弟姐妹小麻和小龍玩得非常開心,而小蜘蛛卻不能融入,讓他感到格格不入。/蜘蛛孩子們扭轉局面佔了蜘蛛小姐和酷利的上風,利用許願網幫助父母控制睡前常規。
epg.episode_synopsis_en:
Squirt feels left out when his two winged siblings have high-flying fun that a little spider can’t join in.
/ The Spider kids turn the tables on Miss Spider and Holley, using the wishing web to help their parents get their bedtime routine under contr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盤絲參加「接片地歌手」的海選,但有天賦卻害羞的孖生妹妹雪滴搶走了她合唱團的位置,讓她感到受傷害。/螞蟻兄弟、尼德和泰德誤導史角和所有陽光派的昆蟲以為冬天還遠,蜘蛛小姐教史角一句古老的格言,先勞後逸...當史角意識到冬天即至,他和蜘蛛小姐向所有蟲展示冷酷的事實:門前寒霜至,亡羊補牢未為晚也。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pansy auditions for the Dribbly Dell Singers, but her feelings are hurt when her talented-but-shy twin sister, Snowdrop, gets her spot in the chorus./ When the ant brothers, Ned and Ted mislead Squirt and all the Sunny Patch bugs into thinking cold w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王不想與人分享他的新火箭驅動滑板,所以把它藏在一個魔法盒子裡。姑毛和比路決定取得它,挑戰國王的意願,最終進入一個更大的新世界。一個充滿樂趣和……危險的世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇后心情不好。國王和孩子們同意舉辦有史以來最好的生日派對。不幸的是,每個參與者對於如何組織女王的驚喜派對都有個別非常特別的想法。它的成功將取決於他們「易地而處」的能力。尤其是女王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen feels gloomy. The King and the children agree to organize the best birthday party ever. Unfortunately each of the participants has a very particular idea as to how to organize the Queen’s surprise party. Its success will depend on their cap

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路厭倦了女王,他認為女王試圖毀掉他所有的冒險和遊戲。在滿天流星的星夜,比路許下一個願望:願女王變回少女,讓他為所欲為。當比路的願望成真,他將必須當個瘋狂的小女王哥哥,並意識到這可能是很艱鉅的任務,有時甚至很危險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is fed up with the Queen, whom he thinks tries to ruin all his adventures and games. On a starry night, full of shooting stars, Bello makes a wish: may the Queen become a young girl again so she can let him do anything he wants. When Bello’s wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒來發現珍愛的頭盔不見了!最重要的是,他的朋友們表現得很奇怪,他們似乎都忘記了他的生日。姑毛很樂意讓一切恢復正常。幸運的是,他收到一個驚喜,可以讓這天成為一個非常特別的日子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its Goomos birthday and his hopes are high. Unfortunately, he wakes to find his precious helmet missing! On top of that his friends are acting strangely and they all appear to have forgotten all about his birthday. Goomo would be happy to have thin

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安高在與比路和姑毛玩耍時弄傷了自己,因此必須在家休息幾天。比路感到內疚,決定搬進安高的房子,直到他的朋友好轉為止。他們對生活的不同看法相交,然後一起發現如果睜大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的細節,也可以很享受。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ongo hurt himself while playing with Bello and Goomo so he must stay at home to rest for several days. Bello feels guilty and decides to move into Ongo’s house until his friend feels better. Their different views on life will meet and together they’l

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔在米娜的實驗室試做自己的實驗。她很快就發現首先需要學習一些基礎知識來避免災難發生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita tries her own experiments in Mina’s lab. She’ll soon discover she first needs to learn some basics in order to avoid a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史角兩個長翅膀的兄弟姐妹小麻和小龍玩得非常開心,而小蜘蛛卻不能融入,讓他感到格格不入。/蜘蛛孩子們扭轉局面佔了蜘蛛小姐和酷利的上風,利用許願網幫助父母控制睡前常規。

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #17
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎一位非常特別的嘉賓積克自己來到節目。不過積克卻興奮得忘了邀請另一位嘉賓。牠們趕得及嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a very special guest Jake to the show. In all the excitement, however, Jake forgot to invite another guest. Will they find someone in time?

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #18
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #18
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎海狸和蜘蛛來到節目。牠們都很特別,會自製家園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Beaver and a Spider to the show. Both of these animals are special because they make their own homes.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #19
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎狼和狒狒來到節目。牠們都喜歡聯群結隊出行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Wolf and a Baboon to the show. These animals like to hang out and travel in groups.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #20
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎袋鼠和青蛙來到節目。牠們都因跳來跳去而享負盛名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Kangaroo and a Frog to the show.  Both of these animals are known for hopping around.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals at play.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about wriggly animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals that hide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查克和狐猴倒數動物界派對動物的頭五位。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chuck and Lemur count down the top five animal partiers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查克和狐猴盘点了最吵闹的五种动物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chuck and Lemur count down the top five noisiest animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 還有比在音樂誕生的星球更適合跳舞的地方嗎?啫堡上的每個人都會向您展示一段舞蹈,這樣我們就可以隨著啫堡的節奏一起跳舞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Is there a better place to dance than the planet where music is born? Every person on Jammbo has a dance to show you so we can all dance together to the rhythm of Jammbo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《小毛孩大百科》能解答小孩們一直喜愛的動物的疑問。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMooPedia answers the questions kids have always wanted to know about their favourite animals

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧賓浩享受在沙中跟朋友玩耍。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lubinho enjoys to play in the sand with his friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿上你的舞鞋,準備好與 ZooMoosic 一起跳舞吧!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strap on your dancing shoes and get ready to boogie with ZooMoosic.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太空人先生訓練孩子們成為小太空人。當太空船出現故障,他們的訓練將受到考驗。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Astronaut trains the children to be Junior Astronauts. Their training is put to the test when something goes wrong with the spaceship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們找出並營救紅鬍子船長失蹤的特別朋友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children find and rescue Captain Redbeards special friend who went missing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們餵飼哥士毛,發現牠更多的隱藏能力。阿絲翠的外星太空狗還能做甚麼?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children feed Cosmo and discover more of his hidden abilities. What else can Astrids alien space dog do?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園侏儒先生的表兄弟從城裡來拜訪,但他們相處得不好。小孩們幫助侏儒們調解衝突。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Garden Gnomes cousins from the city come to visit, but they dont get along very well. The children help the gnomes resolve their conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農夫先生不在,小孩們被委派照顧農場動物。不過,如果他們不知道動物需要甚麼又該怎辦呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are tasked to take care of the farm animals while Mr. Farmer is away.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商人先生有事外出,孩子們不小心把他的攤位弄得一團糟。他們能在他回來前修好嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While Mr. Merchant is away running an errand, the children accidentally make a mess at his stall. Can they fix it before he returns?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿米爾王子有一隻新寵物鳥,但牠有點不妥。牠不能飛!在嘗試各種方法幫牠飛後,孩子們對牠有了驚人發現。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prince Aamil has a new pet bird, but theres something wrong with it. It cant fly! While trying various ways to help the bird fly, the children make a surprising discovery about it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們在紅鬍子想挖的藏寶處建造沙堡,結果會如何?誰會得償所願?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What happens when the kids build their sandcastle at the exact spot that Redbeard wants to dig for treasure?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們協助新的交通督導員香蕉樹先生工作。但如他變得太擅長自己的工作會怎樣呢?看看結果如何!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children help Mr. Banana Tree with his new job as a traffic controller. But what if he becomes too good at his job? Find out what happens!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一些螃蟹付錢給紅鬍子來觀看一場壯觀的馬戲表演。不過,因為莫里士不是最偉大的表演者,所以螃蟹十分生氣!孩子們能幫忙拯救這場表演嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some crabs pay Redbeard to watch a spectacular circus show. However, Maurice is not the greatest showman. The crabs are angry! Will the children be able to help save the show?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添所有的魔術把戲都失效了。一定是他的魔杖壞了!小孩們前往沙漠尋找新魔杖,但最終得到了比他們想像更強大的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: All of Tims magic tricks are failing. It must be because his magic wand is spoilt! The children head to the Desert to get a new magic wand but they end up with something more powerful than they could ever imagine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寶拉的郵遞服務有了第一位付費客戶!寶拉和她的團隊在運送包裹時遇上麻煩。他們將如何確保成功交付呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Paulas Postal Service has its first paying customer! While delivering the package, Paula and her team run into trouble. What will they do to ensure they make a successful delivery?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們和莫里士試圖讓紅鬍子在拍照時微笑,但似乎沒有甚麼成效。甚麼能讓紅鬍子微笑呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children and Maurice are trying to get Redbeard to smile for a photo, but nothing seems to be working. What will make Redbeard smile?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子賣廣告招募新的海盜助手,並承諾給最好的助手提供一輛帥氣的電單車。阿添和鑿奇非常想得到電單車,並爭相取悅紅鬍子,因而犧牲他們的友誼,這樣值得嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Redbeard advertises for new pirate assistants with the promise of a cool motorcycle for the best assistant. Tim and Calc want it badly and compete to please Redbeard. Will this be worth sacrificing their friendship in the process?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們前往遠東參加小豬與熊貓的喜劇才藝表演。但原來是開這些孩子的玩笑,最後會如何發展?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children head to the Far East to join Pig  Pandas comedy talent show. But what happens when the jokes are played on the children?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃氏兄弟、蘇美和小孩們進行一場史詩式的運動大戰。女孩們會玩空手道,男孩們會玩體操。最後到底誰勝誰負?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wong Brothers, Sue-Mae and the children have an epic sports battle. The girls will do karate and the boys will do gymnastics. Who will win?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路突然擁有了強大的力量,這要歸功於一枚滿足他所有願望的警長星章。他的新責任賦予了他如此多的力量,令比路最終希望得到很快就會後悔的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是孩子們相聚並畫畫的好日子,他們都興奮地開始。比路知道他的畫是女王的最愛,他迫不及待地想給她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些東西。比路認為這不公平。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has hurt his back. Everyone thinks of a plan to transport him –safe and sound – to his comfortable bed back in the castle. They must learn to listen to each other and consider even the most absurd options because you never know where the ans

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是孩子們相聚並畫畫的好日子,他們都興奮地開始。比路知道他的畫是女王的最愛,他迫不及待地想給她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些東西。比路認為這不公平。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a wonderful day to draw and the children gather round, exited to get started. Bello knows his drawings are the Queens favorite and he cant wait to show her his latest one. Unfortunately, the Queen is too busy trying to teach Rita something. Be

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help find the rightful home for a Malayan water monitor lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers set forth on a mission to return a leafy sea dragon home to Australian waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王不想與人分享他的新火箭驅動滑板,所以把它藏在一個魔法盒子裡。姑毛和比路決定取得它,挑戰國王的意願,最終進入一個更大的新世界。一個充滿樂趣和……危險的世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇后心情不好。國王和孩子們同意舉辦有史以來最好的生日派對。不幸的是,每個參與者對於如何組織女王的驚喜派對都有個別非常特別的想法。它的成功將取決於他們「易地而處」的能力。尤其是女王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen feels gloomy. The King and the children agree to organize the best birthday party ever. Unfortunately each of the participants has a very particular idea as to how to organize the Queen’s surprise party. Its success will depend on their cap

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路厭倦了女王,他認為女王試圖毀掉他所有的冒險和遊戲。在滿天流星的星夜,比路許下一個願望:願女王變回少女,讓他為所欲為。當比路的願望成真,他將必須當個瘋狂的小女王哥哥,並意識到這可能是很艱鉅的任務,有時甚至很危險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is fed up with the Queen, whom he thinks tries to ruin all his adventures and games. On a starry night, full of shooting stars, Bello makes a wish: may the Queen become a young girl again so she can let him do anything he wants. When Bello’s wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒來發現珍愛的頭盔不見了!最重要的是,他的朋友們表現得很奇怪,他們似乎都忘記了他的生日。姑毛很樂意讓一切恢復正常。幸運的是,他收到一個驚喜,可以讓這天成為一個非常特別的日子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its Goomos birthday and his hopes are high. Unfortunately, he wakes to find his precious helmet missing! On top of that his friends are acting strangely and they all appear to have forgotten all about his birthday. Goomo would be happy to have thin

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安高在與比路和姑毛玩耍時弄傷了自己,因此必須在家休息幾天。比路感到內疚,決定搬進安高的房子,直到他的朋友好轉為止。他們對生活的不同看法相交,然後一起發現如果睜大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的細節,也可以很享受。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ongo hurt himself while playing with Bello and Goomo so he must stay at home to rest for several days. Bello feels guilty and decides to move into Ongo’s house until his friend feels better. Their different views on life will meet and together they’l

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔在米娜的實驗室試做自己的實驗。她很快就發現首先需要學習一些基礎知識來避免災難發生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita tries her own experiments in Mina’s lab. She’ll soon discover she first needs to learn some basics in order to avoid a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿波的一個兄弟走失了/ 毛利在礁石中發現了丹尼蛻下的外骨骼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of Ripple’s brothers has wandered off / Maury discovers Denny’s molted exoskeleton in the reef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花和牠的朋友發現了一條鸚嘴魚/ 泡寶被困在寶箱裡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash and his friends find a parrotfish / Bubbles gets trapped in a treasure chest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀市長必須出席魟魚的遷徙活動,因此由阿燈代其工作一天/ 泡寶尋找終極泥坑。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mayor Sting has to attend a stingray migration so Dunk fills in / Bubbles goes looking for the ultimate mud puddle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鸚嘴魚蒼比決定不再只吃藻類/ 泡寶和阿波遇到一隻水母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chompy the Parrotfish decides she doesn’t want to eat only algae anymore / Bubbles and Ripple meet a jellyfish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太空人先生訓練孩子們成為小太空人。當太空船出現故障,他們的訓練將受到考驗。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Astronaut trains the children to be Junior Astronauts. Their training is put to the test when something goes wrong with the spaceship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們找出並營救紅鬍子船長失蹤的特別朋友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children find and rescue Captain Redbeards special friend who went missing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們餵飼哥士毛,發現牠更多的隱藏能力。阿絲翠的外星太空狗還能做甚麼?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children feed Cosmo and discover more of his hidden abilities. What else can Astrids alien space dog do?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園侏儒先生的表兄弟從城裡來拜訪,但他們相處得不好。小孩們幫助侏儒們調解衝突。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Garden Gnomes cousins from the city come to visit, but they dont get along very well. The children help the gnomes resolve their conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農夫先生不在,小孩們被委派照顧農場動物。不過,如果他們不知道動物需要甚麼又該怎辦呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are tasked to take care of the farm animals while Mr. Farmer is away.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商人先生有事外出,孩子們不小心把他的攤位弄得一團糟。他們能在他回來前修好嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While Mr. Merchant is away running an errand, the children accidentally make a mess at his stall. Can they fix it before he returns?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿米爾王子有一隻新寵物鳥,但牠有點不妥。牠不能飛!在嘗試各種方法幫牠飛後,孩子們對牠有了驚人發現。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prince Aamil has a new pet bird, but theres something wrong with it. It cant fly! While trying various ways to help the bird fly, the children make a surprising discovery about it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們在紅鬍子想挖的藏寶處建造沙堡,結果會如何?誰會得償所願?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What happens when the kids build their sandcastle at the exact spot that Redbeard wants to dig for treasure?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠為儒艮找一個安全的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers seek a safe home for a dugong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠為尋找寬吻海豚的媽媽踏上征途。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers set off on an expedition to find a baby bottlenose dolphins mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠把白腹海鷗帶到湖中,讓牠可以覓食。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers take a white bellied sea eagle to a lake so it can find food.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠引導一隻小蜜蜂回到蜂巢。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers guide a honey bee back to its beehive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠前往草原,為一隻西倉鴞尋找合適的狩獵場。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers depart for the grasslands to find a suitable hunting place for a barn owl.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠來到低地森林幫一隻亞洲象尋找媽媽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers head to the lowland forest to search for a baby Asian elephants mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠把一隻海龜和一些蛋帶回海灘。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers return a baby sea turtle and some eggs to the beach.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠把一隻大鼷鹿帶回雨林的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers return a greater mousedeer to its home in the rainforest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《小毛孩動腦筋》考驗你的動物知識- 一個獨一無二的遊戲節目!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test your animal knowledge on ZooMoos Got Brains -- A game show like no other!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於住在寒冷地方的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals in cold places.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於動物遊玩的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals at play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於蠕動的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about wriggly animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於愛好匿藏的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals that hide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史角和他的兄弟姐妹們嘗試在一天內盡情享樂,卻在陽光派各處留下了舊網,毀掉牠們享受非凡樂趣的機會。/小龍告訴史角「大蟲子不哭」,這隻小蜘蛛決定要封存壞情緒,而不是訴諸眼淚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Squirt and his sibs try to pack the most fun ever into one day, they leave old webs strewn across Sunny Patch and ruin their chance at some extraordinary fun./ When Dragon informs Squirt that big bugs dont cry, the little spider decides to bo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韋高竭盡所想,想讓自己的畫看起來跟小麻相似,但牠發現每個人都有自己獨特的藝術風格。/小龍嘗試教史片拿如何玩莓球,牠欺騙兄弟,讓後者認為牠是名過其實的球員。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wiggle tries everything he can think of to make his painting look like Shimmer’s, only to discover that everyone has his own special style when it comes to art./ When Dragon tries to teach Spinner how to play basketberry, he tricks his brother into t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王不想與人分享他的新火箭驅動滑板,所以把它藏在一個魔法盒子裡。姑毛和比路決定取得它,挑戰國王的意願,最終進入一個更大的新世界。一個充滿樂趣和……危險的世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇后心情不好。國王和孩子們同意舉辦有史以來最好的生日派對。不幸的是,每個參與者對於如何組織女王的驚喜派對都有個別非常特別的想法。它的成功將取決於他們「易地而處」的能力。尤其是女王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen feels gloomy. The King and the children agree to organize the best birthday party ever. Unfortunately each of the participants has a very particular idea as to how to organize the Queen’s surprise party. Its success will depend on their cap

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路厭倦了女王,他認為女王試圖毀掉他所有的冒險和遊戲。在滿天流星的星夜,比路許下一個願望:願女王變回少女,讓他為所欲為。當比路的願望成真,他將必須當個瘋狂的小女王哥哥,並意識到這可能是很艱鉅的任務,有時甚至很危險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is fed up with the Queen, whom he thinks tries to ruin all his adventures and games. On a starry night, full of shooting stars, Bello makes a wish: may the Queen become a young girl again so she can let him do anything he wants. When Bello’s wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒來發現珍愛的頭盔不見了!最重要的是,他的朋友們表現得很奇怪,他們似乎都忘記了他的生日。姑毛很樂意讓一切恢復正常。幸運的是,他收到一個驚喜,可以讓這天成為一個非常特別的日子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its Goomos birthday and his hopes are high. Unfortunately, he wakes to find his precious helmet missing! On top of that his friends are acting strangely and they all appear to have forgotten all about his birthday. Goomo would be happy to have thin

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安高在與比路和姑毛玩耍時弄傷了自己,因此必須在家休息幾天。比路感到內疚,決定搬進安高的房子,直到他的朋友好轉為止。他們對生活的不同看法相交,然後一起發現如果睜大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的細節,也可以很享受。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ongo hurt himself while playing with Bello and Goomo so he must stay at home to rest for several days. Bello feels guilty and decides to move into Ongo’s house until his friend feels better. Their different views on life will meet and together they’l

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔在米娜的實驗室試做自己的實驗。她很快就發現首先需要學習一些基礎知識來避免災難發生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita tries her own experiments in Mina’s lab. She’ll soon discover she first needs to learn some basics in order to avoid a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In postwar Vienna, Austria, Holly Martins, a writer of pulp Westerns, arrives penniless as a guest of his childhood chum Harry Lime, only to learn he has died. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Young writer Richard Collier is met on the opening night of his first play by an old lady who begs him to "Come back to me". Becoming more and more obsessed with her, by self-hypnosis he manages to travel back in timeâ€”where he meets her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: John Thornton, is a fearless man who's after more than gold; he wants to do what's right. Thornton works for the U.S. mail and is the only person daring and smart enough to figure out how to travel the deadly 600 miles from Skagway to Dawson, Alaska in the icy winter. His incredibly dog Buck is by his side and part of how he survives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: George Trent, a British spy, has gone incommunicado in Ibiza. Appleton Porter (Donald Sutherland) is sent to find out what happened to Trent. Porter settles into a small hotel with several busybody guests. He probes them for information about Trent, their former neighbor. Meanwhile, the spy survives several attempts on his life as he attempts to solve the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺,殺掉所有少林弟子.從中倖存出來的兩名弟子,分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下,學習拳法.最終他們挾技擊敗敵人,並為死去師兄弟報仇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighter

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武打明星劉家輝飾演反清組織成員,並逃難到少林寺求藝.為了報仇雪恨,他矢寺要在「天下武宗」少林學懂上乘的武學.他學成少林寺三十五房功夫後,創立少林寺第三十六房功夫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 導演張堅庭在本片體現香港八十年代的大城小景;陳友與妻子惠英紅從大陸來港投靠父親,卻發現他並非如信中所言生活富足.東方之珠的美夢換來悲喜交集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蜈蚣功的鹿峰、蛇功的韋白、蠍子功的孫建、壁虎功的郭追、蛤蟆功的羅莽,各擅勝場,不同型格.電影風格奇特,一開始五毒門清理門戶,派出楊得將五個高手就地正法.同出師門,卻受師父追殺,有人說是喻他一手建立的張家班命运,張徹拍出殺戮的悲劇,沒有他慣常的大義浩然,卻有天地不容的毀滅性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰.太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手.七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭.玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇...文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓九重為奪削鐵如泥的青霜劍,誘殺師弟談鶴鳴;談鶴鳴的妻子耿六娘隱姓埋名在將軍府為傭,伺機奪劍報仇.將軍女兒嬌龍拜六娘為師,練成一身武藝,並與六娘師侄羅翼虎相戀.翼虎順嬌龍之意,深夜到親王府盜劍,然而寡不敵眾,失手被擒;嬌龍率眾營救,與韓九重等人展開連場激戰.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編.故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年醫生時振聲在醫院中發現很多奇難雜症,無法以醫學理論解釋,遂請好友齊中平夫婦共同研究.幾經追查,才發現那些病人均是中了降頭.原來施降者是精通邪術,以「愛情降頭」協助富商追求夢中情人,博取巨額報酬.中平不信妖邪之說,其妻子更不惜以身相試,更被施以「死降」,如果無法破解,二十四小時後便會身亡…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wei Xiao Bao inadvertently enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi, whilst covertly serving rebels seeking the sacred Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters. Caught between rival factions when the Emperor seeks it too, Xiao Bao must rely

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlords beautiful daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大導演李翰祥改編自己大受歡迎的專欄,盡現電影圈光怪陸離的趣事及傳聞,由愛將劉永和戴良純扮演不同角色,保證令你捧腹大笑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This film is an amusing insiders look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiangs popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣東十虎之一譚敏之侄譚聰,在賭館當巡場;一夜,十虎的徒弟及後人等四人,在賭場相聚時,旗人佟七帶著前清官之子小虎突襲,把譚聰殺死.原因是十虎之黎仁昭、譚敏等,昔日曾把父殺死,以助反清義士蔡民義脫險.小虎遂與師叔們聯手,殺死仍在世的十虎及其後人、傳人,為父報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who ret

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鋼琴師李燕南與樂隊指揮女兒陳小芸相愛,常指點她歌唱技巧.小芸在一次代替演出中一鳴驚人,得團主及花花公子杜邦傑力捧.小芸赴星馬演出,心卻惦念燕南,一夜與杜邦傑于車內發生爭執,怎料汽車失事...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unw

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李修賢是一摩托車行東主,曾是著名車手,惟一次意外中傷殘;他對學徒麥德羅甚為賞識,麥因李之啟蒙而在澳門賽車中奪標.李聞悉麥參與非法賽車,予以規勸,惟麥受盛名之累,欲罷不能…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Dannys help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. A

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 淩波的丈夫高遠及其友王俠,均與肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染,孟藉此勒索二人;後孟被殺,高成嫌疑犯,另孟之兄翟諾,亦向高勒索;而淩在家,也接見了穀峰,他聲言有為高洗罪的證據,但要索錢;王妻李香君借貸給淩... 究竟誰是殺孟真凶?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mrs Lins husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lins

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文,為了自由戀愛,脫離父母,從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活.他們生育五個兒女,但生存的擔子日重,二人長期辛勞,終相繼亡故.小兒女頓失庇蔭,直接面對複雜的社會,幾乎各散東西……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文,為了自由戀愛,脫離父母,從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活.他們生育五個兒女,但生存的擔子日重,二人長期辛勞,終相繼亡故.小兒女頓失庇蔭,直接面對複雜的社會,幾乎各散東西……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 赤膽忠心的楊家將,世世代代為國而戰,子子孫孫為民而死,直戰到最後一員虎將楊宗保,不幸在金山之役中了埋伏,全營將士壯烈犧牲.楊宗保身負箭傷,被困金山,以身殉國.楊家滿門為保衛宋朝江山及替楊宗保報仇,在老祖母佘老太君的發起下,組成了一支楊家軍,誓與番邦周旋到底!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河東府教頭王陽受地方土紳孟二達陷害,成殺人疑犯,惟匿藏孟家任教頭.後王收好武青年周平為徒,卻惹孟不滿;原來周、孟兩大族為死敵,孟覺聘王當教頭,實乃養虎為患,遂唆使大盜「一條鞭」施以偷襲,幸王逃過大難,只是受了傷.孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所為,且對王很有好感,遂暗中援手...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wongs caught in the Mongs territory and as punish

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔山派秦五新劍術高超,連敗九十九名劍手,終在最後一擊敗在劍神手上.五新知其欠缺一柄寶劍,遂殺死著名鑄劍師老鷹,奪取稀世的「老鷹寶劍」.老鷹之子燕北悲痛萬分,矢誓報仇,不自量力挑戰五新,結果被打落懸崖之下...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋,其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿,意圖賣瘋傳毒.貞蓮將真相和盤托出,孝文感於貞蓮真情,決意回鄉稟明母親,迎接貞蓮返家.孝文走後,貞蓮萬念俱灰,竟狂飲毒酒,以圖自盡...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a noblemans reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their ro

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大哥成從大陸逃到香港,在屋邨經營茶樓,本想安分守己,卻屢遭惡勢力挑釁,而警方卻袖手旁觀,迫使大哥成和茶樓的朋友們決定以牙還牙!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his frien

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭,插翅虎及活閻王,的武功,他們必定獨霸武林,江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨.活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟,決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎.究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞?誰可挽救一場武林浩劫?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld Kings sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 將少林寺視為眼中釘的清廷,處心積慮地想一舉消滅少林子弟,於是火燒少林寺.事出突然,寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九.其中五名生還弟子,決意為死去的少林弟子報仇.五人潛心修煉終成正果,被後世稱為少林五祖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to becom

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅,與空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住,三女各有愛情際遇;白眉雖愛錢,卻傾情自稱從外地來的路俊,兩人只好互許後會有期之願;朱黛曾迷戀已婚飛機師,分手後又愛上賽車手;姚姚的最大心願是把清白之軀留給丈夫,她本最愛窮工人李吉,李吉卻因自卑而忍痛分手,姚姚嫁予富家子,卻仍掛念李吉...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奸相秦檜偽造十二道金牌,密謀強召抗金前線的岳飛退兵.華山俠士苗龍為救國運,率江湖義士沿途設卡攔截金牌.不料護送金牌的爪牙首領竟是其恩師金彥堂,令苗龍陷入忠義兩難.最終師徒在客棧反目血戰,苗龍雖拚死奪下金牌,卻仍難挽回歷史的千古遺憾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chancellor Qin Hui forges twelve gold medallions to recall General Yue Fei from the wars front line. Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two cl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將;一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞,蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴.後苗寨旱災,蛇王子答應率蛇作法,引水入寨,但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years.  All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sen

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張徹導演的武俠鉅作《水滸傳》的延續.七大梁山的英雄義士為保國家,奉命征討宦官專權.展開一場轟轟烈烈之蕩寇大決戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a sequel to Chang Chehs epic The Water Margin, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「多咀街」是一條丁字形的熱鬧街道,住客大多是各行各業的小市民.他們對社會所發生的大小事情喜歡談論,七嘴八舌,招惹是非;三言兩語,道出人情冷暖,有道是:言為心聲.不管是粵劇藝員、暴發戶、黑社會人物或司機,他們說的話是嬉笑怒罵或冷嘲熱諷也好,都足以反映出現實社會人情百態之一斑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. Howeve

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰.太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手.七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭.玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇...文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 良才見秋容貌美,心懷不軌,竟將其迷姦.秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻.誰知數月後,良才音訊全無,秋容更發現自已懷有身孕,於是馬上去找良才.可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻,更打算將秋容滅口…
