epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貧寒書生張珍投奔相府,卻遭嫌貧愛富的準岳父冷落.碧波潭鯉魚精同情他的遭遇,化身相國千金,深夜與張珍相會,兩人漸生情愫.此事引發「真假千金」鬧相府的風波,更招來張天師降妖圍剿.面對天兵天將,張珍誓死不離,最終感動觀音,令鯉魚精化為凡人,與張珍終成眷屬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellors family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellors daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daught

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局掌門義子.司馬秋利慾薰心,設計弒殺師父,更以暗鏢毀去夏梧面容.重傷的夏梧懷抱年幼長女逃走,懷孕妻子卻於昏迷中遭司馬秋姦污.夏梧隱居深山,將仇恨寄託長女青青,苦心培育其成為武藝高強的「玉面飛狐」,命她下山劫鏢尋仇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daught

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗娘子被邪惡的黑金剛擊敗後,隱居多年,處心積慮要復仇.女俠翠屏勇猛堅毅,為剷除黑金剛,懇求鍾馗娘子收她為徒.娘子與翠屏兩師徒聯手對付黑金剛,也是他大限將至的時侯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knights

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺,殺掉所有少林弟子.從中倖存出來的兩名弟子,分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下,學習拳法.最終他們挾技擊敗敵人,並為死去師兄弟報仇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighter

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女,面對惡霸從不退縮,總是勇敢反抗.當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後,立刻引來他的狠毒報復.幸好,她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救.兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運,改寫結局?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, H

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編.故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 的士司機阿發與少女阿霞相愛已久,但發有神經錯亂,霞為除心理負擔,忍痛分手; 發大鬧霞家並斷指示真心,令霞感動而復合.然發卻不務正業,令霞甚為反感;一次爭執間,發狂性大發,霞流產,再次離開發...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十萬鏢銀被持神鞭作武器的劫鏢者劫去.因神鞭是有「影子神鞭」之稱的武林大師方承天的招牌武器,所以他的嫌疑最大,也因此引來連番追捕.自此以後,方消聲匿跡.十五年後,年輕女子楊寒雲突然出現,更拿著與當年一樣的神鞭.究竟這位女子是誰?「影子神鞭」的下落又如何?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master Shadow Whip, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述一群年青人在愛情和情感相互交錯下,組成多個錯綜複雜的多角戀情.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬騰是雍正的密令組織「血滴子特務團」的其中一位殺手.當馬騰質疑其特務行動是否有違道義時,卻旋即變成被同伴追捕的逃犯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ma Teng is an assassin of the Flying Guillotine Squad, a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯.白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍.兩人在同一學校上課,隱藏夫妻秘密.珍發覺林明常被女生包圍,而林又發現珍常被男老師追求,期間笑料百出.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朱國棟和李明珠本打算結婚,無奈雙方父母為多年死對頭,所以堅決反對婚事.於是二人不惜假裝自殺.有見及此雙方家長最終冰釋前嫌,答應二人成婚.此時,唱片公司宣佈會為出棟的歌曲版,最終可謂雙喜臨門.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announ

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,某寺青年僧人「瘋子」,性格瘋瘋癲癲,行為全不符僧人規範.該寺主持玄明方丈卻認為「瘋子」與佛有緣,並因應其性格與氣質,授以「癲羅漢拳」.「瘋子」有了武功後,動輒出拳傷人,方丈只得將其逐出寺門...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandits son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his Crazy Lo Han Fist improves with every fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片是根據《聊齋》中之《書癡》改編,故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺負,搬進常鬧鬼的「孝廉府」.然後玉柱遇上了顏如玉,二人及後結成夫婦.郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉,將其迷奸.良金妻妾更毒害如玉,如玉化成厲鬼,將中元、良金等人殺害.玉柱因如玉已不在人世,不禁一陣辛酸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片講述唐僧、孫悟空、豬八戒及沙和尚一行四人往西天取經,行至西梁女兒國,國內全是女人,而傳宗接代生兒育女全靠「招胎泉」,飲過這泉水便可成孕,但也只能生女.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易,庶室程夫人既憤且惱,對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥,催促二人早日成親.居易見雪雁貌醜而癡,嚇得留書出走.富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久,趁此良機冒充居易,依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角,配搭新鮮;而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出,更令人笑破肚皮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares hi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,民初北方軍閥混戰,民不聊生,紛紛向南逃難,三位青年王緒、金正平和魚漢生,夾在難民群中,來到戰區邊沿.王因出手營救一女難民,致遭地方民團首領陳祖光的手下追捕,幸得風塵女子紅菱所救……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town wh

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 男孩小吉的父母離異後,希望尋找快樂的人生.一天,小吉喜遇好心鬼簡人,並結成好友.好心鬼決定要幫助小吉的父母復合,令小吉得到真正的快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄龍扮演的小李悄然回到愛侶故園之旁隱居,遙對窗中倩影,而不相見,直至發生危機,小李才露面相告,並且挺身赴難.有不少高手為爭武林排名而找小李決鬥,小李又要對付惡勢力龐大的幫主谷峰,於是小李找尋舊友阿飛相助,但阿飛被陰險美女林仙兒所迷,簡直變成廢人,小李於是揭破這女人的假面目,並且設法使阿飛振作起來
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武,後更考得秀才功名,堪稱文武全才.同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對,均不知其是女兒身.聞母見女兒年紀不小,不該再扮男裝,勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿.不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同,一時無法抉擇,遂決定由天定奪,怎知陰差陽錯,選婿之箭落於撰之手中.蜚娥後悔不已,才知自己意屬子中…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a Generals daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐僧師徒西行取經,受阻於烈火綿延的火焰山,唯有鐵扇公主的芭蕉扇方能滅火.然而因紅孩兒一事,牛魔王夫婦拒不相助.孫悟空遂與二人展開「三調芭蕉扇」的智勇較量.越過火焰山後,師徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹設下的長生圈套.面對詭計多端的妖精,悟空再施神通,護師脫險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內,流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據,得以順水推舟假扮縣長,把各官員玩弄於股掌之中,峰迴路轉,結局卻出人意表.全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默,也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕龍劍飛武功低劣,但在一次偶然的機會下,被火魂邪神古漢魂收為義子,並獲傳授八式如來神掌.龍劍飛從此脫胎換骨,成為武林高手.為報師仇,古漢魂命龍劍飛下山替他找仇人報仇,江湖風暴遂再牽起…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddhas Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 杜孟飛奉命下山闖蕩江湖,途中救出遭黑道中人捉拿的沐婉兒,杜挺身相救,沐萬分感激.未幾,杜又救出被黑道中人圍攻的少女李賽男.及後,杜無意中得知一段二十年前的江湖恩怨,黑道首領是李之殺父仇人,而沐則是黑道首領失散的女兒…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬茂押鏢時,遇女贼袁玉蓉,舉刀要殺之際,卻被袁的美麗媚態吸引,後兩人互生愛慕,更發現憑獨門武器「十二金錢鏢」名震天下的俞劍平,與背後操控袁的老頭,有段血海深仇…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - Twelve Deadly Coins and the old master who cont

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 仇連環在上海灘以拳頭打出天下,乃好勇鬥狠的典型人物.仇為了交際花沈菊芳不惜豁出性命,與著名幫會首腦之子及同伴展開連場明爭暗鬥,亦成為幫會爭奪地盤的嫁禍目標.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天爺是江城最大的毒梟,行事謹慎,從不親自參與交易。平江市公安局禁毒大隊的大隊長陳昌榮為了抓住天爺,自願成為臥底進入天爺的販毒團夥,終極對決一觸即發。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Tien, the most powerful drug dealer in Jiang City, is always on the alert and never gets involved in any drug trafficking personally. To arrest Master Tien, the captain of the narcotics team at Ping Jiang City volunteers to be an undercover in Master Tiens drug gang, resulting in a fierce combat.

epg.programme_title_en: The Whirlwind of Sword and Fairy
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 百年前,仙劍門祖師爺張掌門與異人首領幽皇大戰七天七夜,最終打敗幽皇,並將異人族兵器「九黎」封印。百年後,仙劍門弟子張之霖成為新掌門。此時發現鎮上女人離奇失蹤,原來是幽皇吸食女人精魄練就神功。仙劍門布下..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 100 years ago, Master Zhang triumphed over Inhuman clan leader, Emperor Yu, in a fierce 7-day duel and sealed their weapons after that. A century later, Zhangs disciple, Lin, assumes leadership and discovers that the spirits of the vanished women are devoured by Emperor Yu for boosting his power. The war between good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 元朝末年,一個名為修羅幕主的神秘組織聲稱擁有武林至寶八極玄盒。他們邀請了頂尖的武林高手參加武林大會,事實上想用秘製毒藥控制他們為組織效力。太極宗師張三豐為要揭露組織的陰謀參加了武林大會,最終解開了八極..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. Tai Chi master Zhang San Feng attends the event to uncover their plot and successfully destroys the evil gang in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘇家布行二房長子蘇文興,渴望繼承家業,卻在與堂妹蘇檀兒的較量中被擊敗。興偶然得知他在眾人眼中只是一個吉祥物,為了證明自己的能力,興決心往外闖一番事業,但卻遭受連連挫折。正當他絕望之際,一位舊日同窗高甜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Wen Xing aspires to take over the familys textile shop, but loses the control to his cousin. To prove himself, he sets out on a journey to find his own success but faces repeated setbacks. In despair, he reconnects with an old classmate who collaborates with him on a business venture, resulting in a series of amusing and chaotic escapades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天時期,京城長安接連發生了好幾次離奇死亡案件,因為死因不明,以致忠烈祠飛天壁畫顯靈殺人的謠言愈演愈烈,百姓紛紛認為是天降不祥,人心惶惶。在地方屢破奇案的狄仁傑奉命調查此案,最終不僅破除了謠言,也通..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the era of Empress Wu, rumours about mysterious murder cases are spreading in Chang An City. The people are worried and see it as an ominous sign. Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇門派和五毒派為江湖兩大門派,而這兩大派為了“皇家龍種花落誰家而各施各法,奇門派誤打誤撞中揭穿了皇叔試圖阻止皇帝有子嗣的陰謀。皇叔派五毒派弟子秀明試圖毒害皇太子,而奇門則派出多美。多美為人善良,且鍾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老段多年前因涉嫌一樁案件入獄,而剛出獄的他為搞清當年真相,決定要謀劃一場大騙局。怎料此行動卻捲入了他與三個前妻所生的三個性格不同的孩子。一家四口一邊聯手抗敵,一邊互相搞破壞,而這一切都逐漸走向失控及不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Released from jail after an alleged offence, Lao Duan plans a scam to uncover the truth behind the past happenings. His three kids, each of distinct character, get involved in the plan. The family join hands to defeat the enemy, but at the same time, also making troubles for themselves.  As the situation spirals, the ending ia anyones guess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群偷獵者在公海上對鯊魚進行殘酷的捕殺,激怒了大白鯊。偷獵者死於鯊魚的口中,之後盛怒的大白鯊把注意力轉向了在附近遊艇上慶祝畢業的四個好友。於是,四人與大白鯊之間展開了一場激烈的生死搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A big white shark is enraged following a shark hunt by the poachers, who are then killed by it. Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大陳天啟年間,發生了西域舞姬控物懸浮事件,負責靈異怪事的部門“夜行司派出陳淩前往無相城調查。城內叛徒木道人假意幫陳,其實想奪走城內的異能植物日輪花,讓大陳百姓感染花毒癲狂噬人,以報服大陳和無相城..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在香港讀書的少年葉問,意外卷入英國斯塔克集團綁架中國婦女走私到海外的人口販賣案中。葉挺身而出怒打綁匪解救出一批被拐的女子,不料遭到激烈報覆,更連累了身邊的朋友。葉問開始反思,知道個人力量不足夠對抗斯塔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Ip Man battles a British kidnapping gang involved in trafficking Chinese women. As he fights to rescue the captives, he becomes a target of revenge, even endangering his friends. Recognizing his limits, Ip Man works with the patriots to expose the gang’s thrilling conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少林習武歸來的方世玉,本打算過平常人的生活,但剛回到家鄉肇慶便牽扯到一樁貪腐案中。朝廷貪官的爪牙鄂爾多帶隊殺人滅口並企圖銷毀證據,方世玉雖面對好友周蓉的慘死,母親被擒為人質,但卻面無懼色,決意反抗到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having mastered the Shaolin martial arts, Fang Shi Yu yearns for a tranquil existence back home but becomes entangled in a corruption scandal. The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重案組臥底警員山哥向高級督察唯Sir發送線報,说大毒梟金先生將會親自主持一宗涉及金額達二千萬美元的毒品交易。其實這是個為了找出誰是臥底而設計的陷阱,山哥身份暴露後被黑幫追殺,而其臥底身份也突然被警方刪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shans identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jins conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,在方圓八百里之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐,收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞,最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤,誓要捉拿邵宏淵,並要協助百姓們安全撤離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,在方圓八百里之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐,收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞,最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤,誓要捉拿邵宏淵,並要協助百姓們安全撤離..

However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天意是天界出名的留級生,因前世孽緣未了無法成仙,後來一次意外他無意釋放了雪女令她越獄下凡,在捉拿雪女過程中,天意發現自己竟是害她淪為雪妖的人。為了彌補過錯,天意自願在陰間路上漂泊千年,一番磨難後,二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清河聶氏處理其祖傳藏刀古墓的危機時,兄長聶明玦帶領弟弟聶懷桑倆人攜手共渡難關,合力將古墓復原,確保聶氏族人平安。在過程中二人雖然有矛盾,但在經歷危難後,聶懷桑從膽小怕事的世家子弟變得成熟穩重,而聶明玦..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two brothers, Jue and Sang, team up to restore the ancestral tomb of the Nie Clan and protect the clans safety. Despite conflicts between the siblings, Sang becomes more mature and responsible after overcoming the difficulties. As Jue gets to know his younger brother, he helps prepare him to become the future clan leader.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白澤和淩風自幼一起在崑崙派長大,二人因誤入秘境,得到了昊天鏡及絕世魔功。後因淩風修煉魔功之事曝光,兩人被逐出師門,來到白馬鎮,在這裡找到心愛之人。不料崑崙派突然來追殺他們,使淩風愛人慘死,令他墜入魔道..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bai and Ling are expelled from Kunlun Sect after acquiring a mystical mirror and a forbidden martial arts skill. They both found love along the way, but when the Kunlun sect members hunt them down and kill Lings lover, Ling is devastated and decides to turn evil. To uphold justice, Bai subdues Ling and found the Shushan Sect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三國時期,一代名將關羽在麥城之戰被吳國將軍潘璋所殺,青龍偃月刀也被奪走。兩年後蜀國君主劉備親征為關羽報仇,任命關羽之子關興組成小隊,秘密執行破壞吳軍水寨防禦中樞的任務。關興突破重重險阻,最終與殺父仇人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Pan Zhang of the Wus killed General Guan Yu and took away his Green Dragon Crescent Blade. Two years later, Emperor Liu Bei brings an army led by Guan Xing, the son of Guan Yu, to attack Wus waterfront defence. Guan Xing overcomes all challenges and fights against General Pan Zhang to avenge his fathers death, and reclaims the blade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋朝年間,法醫宋慈來到長汀縣任職。一天晚上,突然有一男一女同時喪命,宋得知後立刻介入調查,驗屍過後發現事有蹊蹺,並不是簡單的殺人案。此時宋想到了丹青,可以說在長汀縣沒有丹不知道的事情。倆人於是合作找尋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Song dynasty, Changdings newly appointed forensic scientist, Song Ci, probes into the sudden deaths of a man and a woman. His inquest reveals a mysterious murder plot, and Song Ci decides to join forces with Dan Qing, who knows everything about Changding County, to unravel the truth behind the murders.

epg.programme_title_tc: 武狀元蘇乞兒之天降神諭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末期,西方列強在中國橫行霸道,百姓民不聊生。此時民間天降“神諭,傳言大清要亡,加上顧命大臣接連暴斃,讓傳言更加沸騰。皇上任命九門提督富察·禦恒徹查此案,富察也請來好友蘇燦幫忙。燦發現刺客應該是用..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Qing dynasty, people are suffering from destitution. A divine omen and death of some ministers have sparked rumours of Qings downfall. Fu Cha is tasked by the Emperor to investigate, so he enlists the help of Su Can, who uncovers a brutal assassination plot involving illusions and unravels the secret behind the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明德市郊外發生了一宗拋屍命案,公安局副局長楊棟帶領整個警隊展開深入調查。他們逐步揭開了以企業家林峰為首的頂峰集團涉嫌殺人、放高利貸、及開設賭場等罪行。隨著對掃除黑勢力專案的持續進行,那些無惡不作的犯罪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A police deputy chief leads an investigation about a body discovered in Ming De Town, and gradually unveils a series of crimes, including murder, loan sharking and casino activities by a company owned by entrepreneur Lin Feng. The police go all out to fight vigorously against the criminals as anti-triad operations continue...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 徐震從昏迷中驚醒時,發覺身處在封閉的鐵箱之中,跟著一陣聲響後,鐵箱自動打開。他走出鐵箱,見到一片熱帶叢林,還發現林依娜及其他倖存者,眾人都來自不同國家,然而如何被運到這裡全然不知。大家在叢林中不但要面..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Xu finds himself trapped inside an iron box after awaking from a coma. As the box opens, he finds himself in a tropical forest together with other survivors, all not knowing how they ended up there. Not only do they have to face various crisis and attacks from beasts, they also have to uncover the truth behind it all so as to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孫悟空被壓五指山下四百年時,碰巧被阿一所救。而龍太子得知悟空已逃出,要報當年東海龍宮被毀之仇,便利用悟空昔日好友蛟魔王刺殺悟空,但刺殺失敗,不過阿一被俘虜。為了救阿一,悟空與龍太子從海里打到南天門。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped under Mount Wuzhi for 400 years, the Monkey King is saved by Ah Yi, but is targeted to be assassinated under the Prince Dragons orders. Though the mission fails, Ah Yi is captured and Monkey King battles the Prince Dragon across land and sea to rescue her. He finally redeems himself and returns to Mount Wuzhi to continue his training.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青雲堂的女掌門於勝男為了完成病重父親的願望,急於結婚。她在相親時認識了牛多多,而牛在威逼利誘下簽了假結婚協議。正當勝男漸漸被牛的善良和純真吸引,多年前被勝男父親逐出師門的師兄林傑歸來,並用牛威脅勝男接..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Sheng Nan rushes to get married to fulfil her dying fathers wish and forces Niu, a man she just knew, to sign a bogus marriage agreement. As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青雲堂的女掌門於勝男為了完成病重父親的願望,急於結婚。她在相親時認識了牛多多,而牛在威逼利誘下簽了假結婚協議。正當勝男漸漸被牛的善良和純真吸引,多年前被勝男父親逐出師門的師兄林傑歸來,並用牛威脅勝男接..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Sheng Nan rushes to get married to fulfil her dying fathers wish and forces Niu, a man she just knew, to sign a bogus marriage agreement. As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀七十年代,香港在英國殖民統治下貪腐嚴重,黑惡勢力橫行,毒梟坤哥及豪哥大賺不義之財。廉政公署人員白玫瑰奉命潛伏到黑幫大佬豪哥身邊收集罪證。玫瑰與豪哥日漸熟識,兩人互生情愫。面對一面是將毒梟繩之以法..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 錦毛鼠白玉堂因不滿展昭被賜禦貓封號,同結拜兄弟“陷空島五鼠在東京火神節上盜取火神像,以此羞辱負責巡防治安的展昭。不料二人在爭搶火神像時,祭祀大典和整個煙花坊突起水澆不滅的大火,無辜百姓被燒成灰燼。白..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Upset by Constable Zhangs prestigious title of Imperial Cat, Bai and his sworn brother steal a god statue during the Tokyo God of Fire Festival to embarass Zhang. Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

epg.programme_title_en: The Thousand Faces of Fei Jia
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王小俠本是一個胸無大志,在市井街頭討生活的小鎮青年,與父親老瞎子生活在十隱鎮,唯一的願望就是能治好父親的眼疾。一次偶然令王小俠邂逅了沈藍兒,並意外地捲入了一場陰謀之中。而王小俠為了找能治好父親的眼疾方..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his fathers eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太平洋的某處孤島上建立了一座沒有法律限製的「無罪之城」,眾多犯罪分子慕名前往,以求庇護。國際特種兵唐柯在無罪之城執行任務時不幸落入索蘭的圈套,逃生時發現自己體內被注射毒劑,生命只剩下幾小時。面對妻子被..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以阿古力為首的狼衛軍攻打硫勒城,企圖得到竊天氏的龍脈寶藏和天下第一美人將軍史天驕。守城將軍史萬夫寡不敵眾,與好友肖不平密謀,利用《竊天書》設計反攻狼衛軍。史為了擊退狼衛軍,拯救自己的女兒和全城百姓,竟..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.programme_title_tc: 封神榜: 決戰萬仙陣
epg.programme_title_en: The First Myth Clash of Gods
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Shang dynasty, the deities of Tong Tian Cult are killed by the Zhou army led by Jiang Zi Ya. Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊防部隊正在追蹤國內最大毒梟組織旭東商會的一批價值數百萬美元的毒品,卻被劉老三團夥搶走。警方找到在監獄服刑劉的兄弟大飛,說服他幫忙找回毒品。組織老大黃旭東知道貨被搶,便找了國際僱傭軍準備捉人搶貨。邊防..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Recruited from prison for an undercover mission, convict Da Fei returns to the criminal underworld to investigate his former sworn brother, who stole a cartel drug shipment. However, when ruthless mercenaries kidnap his mother, Da Fei joins forces with border police in a desperate battle for justice and redemption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋末年,國家陷入內憂外患的局面。狄族聯合魔教,妄想踏平中原稱霸江湖,危難之際,無極派大弟子張君寶又名張三豐挺身而出,協助朝廷擊退敵軍,卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗,死傷慘重。為了振興門派,保衛家園,張毅然..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1996年之前的香港,雪麗在自己的婚禮現場遭遇劫匪挾持,並目睹丈夫死於匪徒槍下。雪現於一家射箭館任職,在颱風之夜意外滯留大樓內,並目擊當年同一幫匪徒在大廈內殺人。在逃亡過程中,她遇到了同為滯留者的盲眼..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During her wedding in 1996, Xue Li is taken hostage by gangsters and saw her husband being killed. One night in a typhoon, Xue Li is forced to stay at her workplace in a building, where she witnesses another murder by the same group of gangsters. As she tries to escape, she meets a blind old man and they must fight for survival together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏,便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡,及後得知是交給日本人,便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引,陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓渺是八仙之一韓湘子的化身,在一個缺水猶如沙漠的世界一路向東歷練。而正在執掌東海的龍女因失去記憶,化成了一條魚精,意外遇到和自己有宿世因緣的韓渺。二人走在一起,在東遊途中受到高人指點去尋找 “龍門 ..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長安大理寺捕快郝龍霄神功蓋世,卻為救被妖獸傷害的妹妹,被幻獸妖魔之王鬼車所利用,得奪取各樣法器來助鬼車開啟陣法。原來鬼車的目的是吸聚百姓精血,顛覆人類,以幻獸來控制世界。幸而郝識破鬼車的陰謀,在危急關..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣帶詔。蘅王請魏侯爺找出衣帶詔,並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上,而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕,與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the oppressive rule of Emperor Heng, some volunteers sign on the Belt Oath to overthrow the government. The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Driving pleasure in winter
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Slippery or muddy roads and bad visibility are circumstances that often spoil driving pleasure in winter. We took two almost identical Porsche 911's to an icy test track. Also: drifting fun in the snow with the Suzuki SX4 S-Cross.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Volkswagen Golf
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Volkswagen Golf is nothing more but a reasonable car - there's nothing really exciting about it, but still it's a mega-seller. The Golf is compatible with the masses and dominates the compact car class since its market introduction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Porsche Motorsport
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Be it the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the Monte Carlo Rally or Formula 1: Porsche won it all at least once. Even the first prototype was a race winner, and the successes of the Spyder in the Carrera Panamericana or the Targa Florio are unforgettable.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German Convertibles
epg.episode_synopsis_en: German convertibles like the the Porsche 911 Cabriolet or the Mercedes-AMG Roadster enjoy a worldwide reputation. They stand for perfection and reliability and are considered the embodiment of status and an expression of lifestyle and joy of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Italian Super Sports Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Italian super sports cars like the Ferrari „La Ferrari“, the Lamborghini Aventador or the Pagani Huayra are the most beautiful and fastest cars in the world, created by the best designers. Italian super sports cars are dreams made reality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - SUV Girlpower
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nancy and Nadia, two daring Jordanian women, took part in the Conti 4x4 Trophy. Also: two of our female editors test the Asian SUVs SsangYong Rexton and Hyundai Grand Santa Fe. Also: the BMW X5 M, a sports car in an SUV outfit?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - SUV Concepts
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Bentley EXP 9F and Jaguar C-X17 are concept cars the two manufacturers presented before they started making their own luxury SUVs. Also: how did Toyota, Nissan or Subaru see the future of the SUV? And: Mercedes-Benz' Unimog concept car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Changing the model
epg.episode_synopsis_en: BMW got into the electric mobility business with their ActiveE and i3 models. We visited the company's technology office in Silicon Valley. Also: the Stuck brothers at the test track with the Mercedes C 63 AMG. And: the Audi A3 Sportback.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Essen Motor Show
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Essen Motor Show focuses both on the latest trends in car tuning as well as the usual performance enhancement in quite obvious but also unusual car models. We took a look around this special fare and talked to some of the creative minds.

epg.programme_title_tc: Stunt Heroes - The new stunt convertible
epg.programme_title_en: Stunt Heroes - The new stunt convertible
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The new stunt convertible
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A skidding lorry versus a remote-controlled van. Stunt coordinator Christoph Domanski plan is to separate the roof from the rest of the vehicle. If his idea works, the team will create a unique stunt convertible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Typically German
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What are the characteristics of a typical German car? Do stereotypes like functionality, reliability but also a certain dullness paint a realistic picture? Also, we explored if the Volkswagen Golf GTE could bring new impulses to the brand's model range.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Sporty Elegance
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 4-door coupes combine the best of two worlds, the performance of a coupe and the style of a limousine. We took a closer look at three examples of this car subspecies, the Audi A7, BMW's 4 Series Gran Coupe, and the Mercedes-Benz CLA models.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Fun Factor
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The top-of-the-line specimens of a car model range are built for pure driving pleasure. We put the VW Golf R, the Audi TTS and the BMW M 235i to the test in order to see if they are worthy of bearing the crown of their model range.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - British Coupes
epg.episode_synopsis_en: British coupes are instant classics and just as cool as James Bond. Aston Martin, Bentley and Jaguar produce the most exclusive and elegant coupes in the world. Their distinctive design is still inspired by the iconic Jaguar E-Type and Aston Martin DB5.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - British Limousines
epg.episode_synopsis_en: British limousines are the embodiment of luxury, they are the automotive upper class. Built with the most exclusive materials, these limousines like the Rolls Royce Phantom, Bentley Mulsanne or Jaguar XJ combine luxury, comfort and power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - British Super Sports Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: British super sports cars like the Aston Martin Vanquish, the Bentley Continental GT Speed or McLaren's P1 are among the most spectacular and beautiful sports cars in the world. It's not just about power but also grace and style.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - British Convertibles
epg.episode_synopsis_en: British convertibles like the Jaguar F-Type, the Aston Martin V8 Vantage or the Bentley Continental are elegant and sportier than many other cars. They enjoy cult status all over the world. After all, fast open-top two-seaters were invented in the UK.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Normal vs. Lifestyle SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The SUVs Nissan X-Trail and BMW X4 aren't typical offroaders. We witnessed the presentation of the new X-Trail model and BMW's premiere of their X4. Also: the Steinbeißer Trophy, where unusual offroad vehicles take part in a demanding rally.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - American SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the US, SUVs aren't usually considered just workhorses but rather treated as everyday vehicles. Americans don't want to miss out on space, comfort and loading capacity. We show you the Chevrolet Suburban, Jeep Cherokee and GMC Yukon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Racing fever
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The snowmobile race in Saalbach-Hinterglemm is the winter equivalent of the Formula 1. Also: at the Puma Race-Off Formula 1 driver Nico Rosberg invited footballer Sergio Aguero to a tour of the race track. And: Sebastian Vettel's cameo in a music video.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Animal-like Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Los Angeles, Dean Malay put the Hollywood appeal of the Volkswagen Beetle Convertible to the test. Also: at the BMW Design Night the Bavarian manufacturer showcased its newest creations. And: the Stuck brothers with the Lexus IS-F at the test track.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Moment of Force
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dennis Rostek races the Mathilda Racing GT-R1 at the Nürburgring Nordschleife. Also: the two sons of racing legend Hans-Joachim Stuck take the BMW 550d to the test track. And: could the Volkswagen Golf 7 be a suitable Bond car?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - City Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2015 Audi presented a facelift for their city racer A1. We put this compact to the test. Also: it's a tough competition in the compact class, and Renault and Peugeot also want a piece of the pie. We compared the Renault Twingo and the Peugeot 108.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Want Some More?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If you decide to purchase the Volkswagen Polo GTI or Citroen's DS4 SoChic you neither have to give up convenience nor performance. Also: Nissan doesn't hold back when it comes to their luxury brand Infiniti. We took the Q50 hybrid RWD to the test.

epg.programme_title_tc: Stunt Heroes - Flip through a cola truck
epg.programme_title_en: Stunt Heroes - Flip through a cola truck
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Flip through a cola truck
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stunt man Dominik Kowalski is an expert for falls, drops and body stunts. Today, everything will be different as he is supposed to be the stunt car driver. His objective is to do a flip through a cola truck.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Cannon
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes have a new car cannon in their equipment arsenal that accelerates a car in one second from zero to 70 km/h. The team tests the cannon after shooting a wild car chase on the autobahn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Ford Mustang
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ford Mustang is the icon of all sports coupes and convertibles - no other car conveys so much the lifestyle of the 1960s. With its striking shape and powerful engines the Mustang drove itself into the hearts of millions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Mini
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland or the British royals, they all drove the Austin Mini. Designed on a napkin, the Mini starts an incredible career in 1959: the revolutionary Mini is considered the prototype of all small cars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Tuned SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SUVs usually are rather impressive right out of the factory, but there are many tuning and customizing options. In this episode we present Kelleners BMW X5, the Mercedes Brabus B63 and the Porsche Cayenne tuned by Techart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Small, strong, stylish
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the Audi A1 becomes the S1 and the Golf gets an R in its name, these small cars turn into all-wheel beasts. Also: the Mini Countryman gets a rejuvenation. And: a test drive with the best-selling Volvo XC60.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Hans Herrmann
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the 1950s to 1970s Hans Herrmann came to fame as a successful Formula 1 and sportscar driver for manufacturers like Porsche, Mercedes-Benz and Maserati who also won also the 24 Hours of Le Mans several times.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Sabine Schmitz
epg.episode_synopsis_en: People called her the "Queen of the Nordschleife" when she used to drive her Porsche or BMW racing cars at the Nürburgring's famous Nordschleife. Sabine Schmitz was a successful racing driver before she took a career turn by working as a TV presenter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Porsche Panamera
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2004 Porsche decided to build their Carrera GT in Leipzig and then to produce a four-door sedan in parallel to the Cayenne, the Porsche Panamera. Before this car can hit the streets, it needs to pass 71 stations in the production plant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - AMG
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The letters AMG stand for a company that meets the highest automotive standards. This tuning subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz develops vehicles that are in high demand, both on the streets and racing tracks alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2015 Audi presented a facelift for their city racer A1. We put this compact to the test. Also: it's a tough competition in the compact class, and Renault and Peugeot also want a piece of the pie. We compared the Renault Twingo and the Peugeot 108.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Want Some More?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If you decide to purchase the Volkswagen Polo GTI or Citroen's DS4 SoChic you neither have to give up convenience nor performance. Also: Nissan doesn't hold back when it comes to their luxury brand Infiniti. We took the Q50 hybrid RWD to the test.

epg.programme_title_tc: Stunt Heroes - Flip through a cola truck
epg.programme_title_en: Stunt Heroes - Flip through a cola truck
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Flip through a cola truck
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stunt man Dominik Kowalski is an expert for falls, drops and body stunts. Today, everything will be different as he is supposed to be the stunt car driver. His objective is to do a flip through a cola truck.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Cannon
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes have a new car cannon in their equipment arsenal that accelerates a car in one second from zero to 70 km/h. The team tests the cannon after shooting a wild car chase on the autobahn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Ford Mustang
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ford Mustang is the icon of all sports coupes and convertibles - no other car conveys so much the lifestyle of the 1960s. With its striking shape and powerful engines the Mustang drove itself into the hearts of millions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Mini
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland or the British royals, they all drove the Austin Mini. Designed on a napkin, the Mini starts an incredible career in 1959: the revolutionary Mini is considered the prototype of all small cars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Tuned SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SUVs usually are rather impressive right out of the factory, but there are many tuning and customizing options. In this episode we present Kelleners BMW X5, the Mercedes Brabus B63 and the Porsche Cayenne tuned by Techart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Small, strong, stylish
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the Audi A1 becomes the S1 and the Golf gets an R in its name, these small cars turn into all-wheel beasts. Also: the Mini Countryman gets a rejuvenation. And: a test drive with the best-selling Volvo XC60.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Hans Herrmann
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the 1950s to 1970s Hans Herrmann came to fame as a successful Formula 1 and sportscar driver for manufacturers like Porsche, Mercedes-Benz and Maserati who also won also the 24 Hours of Le Mans several times.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Sabine Schmitz
epg.episode_synopsis_en: People called her the "Queen of the Nordschleife" when she used to drive her Porsche or BMW racing cars at the Nürburgring's famous Nordschleife. Sabine Schmitz was a successful racing driver before she took a career turn by working as a TV presenter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Porsche Panamera
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2004 Porsche decided to build their Carrera GT in Leipzig and then to produce a four-door sedan in parallel to the Cayenne, the Porsche Panamera. Before this car can hit the streets, it needs to pass 71 stations in the production plant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - AMG
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The letters AMG stand for a company that meets the highest automotive standards. This tuning subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz develops vehicles that are in high demand, both on the streets and racing tracks alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Parking Wars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not only in the big cities it's a growing struggle for parking spots. . We took the BMW X6, the Citroen Cactus and the Smart forfour to town in order to find out how these cars would cope in this situation and surrounding.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - Rear-wheel drive for everyone
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Rear-wheel drive for everyone
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Rear-wheel drive for everyone
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cars with a rear-wheel drive are usually considered to be agile but also a bit capricious in regards to their handling. Does this also apply to the Porsche GT3 and the Smart? In addition: the sporty midsize sedan model range, BMW's 3 Series.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Drift, Fly & Fire
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes from the German company Action Concept really let it rip. This time stuntman Paul slides through under an exploding vehicle. At the same time gangster bride Anna flies through the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Salto Mortale
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes face a new mission: performing a front-flip through the air with a stuntman behind the wheel of an estate wagon. Stuntmen Daniel and Lars display a brilliant fight choreography in some spectacular driving scenes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German Limousines
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Whether it is the Mercedes S-Class, the BMW 7-series or the Audi A8, limousines „Made in Germany“ are considered status symbols, setting standards when it comes to comfort, pioneering technologies and safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German Coupes
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With their avantgarde design, superior technology and driving pleasure, German coupes like the Porsche 911, the Mercedes S-Class Coupe, the BMW 6-series or the Audi RS5 embody the passion for driving.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Fascination offroad
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We test drove the Rallye Defender and examined how a Jeep Wrangler with only few modifications can double in price. Also: how does the Fiat Panda 4x4 fare in Iceland? Also: Land Rover's Bowler Defender and Volvo's 6-wheeler, the Laplander.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - All-Wheel Drive on snow
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We spent a day in snowy Austria with rally professional Niki Schelle in a Suzuki SX4 S-Cross. Also: why is the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution perfect for drifting? And: Mercedes and Chrysler present their all-wheel concept cars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Ferrari
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ferrari - the name alone raises the pulse. No other sports car has as much magic and myth as the fiery red icons from Maranello. Whether on the road or on the race track, these cars are the centre of attention.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German Super Sports Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Whether it is the Porsche 918 Spyder, the Audi R8, the Mercedes AMG GT or the BMW i8 – German super sports cars are the fastest and most coveted in the world, with their breathtaking top speeds and incredible engine power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Autonomous driving
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autonomous driving is seen as the future of mobility. Assistance systems help drivers overtaking other cars, check if there’s another car in the driver’s blind spot or warn the driver to take a break when he shows signs of fatigue.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Fresh Air Experience
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Smart offers its iconic city car with a convertible option. The Mini cabriolet is bigger and provides room for four people. When it comes to roadster feeling, the Mazda MX-5 is on top of the list. We took a closer look at these three open-top contenders.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - Drives of the Future
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Drives of the Future
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Drives of the Future
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Paris Motor Show features the automotive world of tomorrow. In 2016 Mercedes-Benz introduced their 'Generation EQ' and Volkswagen announced to build 20 new electrified models by 2020, possibly in order to distract from the emission scandal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Remote Control
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stuntman Tobi operates an Artega GT at full speed via remote control. This is just a warm-up before the big stunt, in which he drives a car up a steep ramp at 68 mph. The question is: How high can remote-controlled cars fly?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Graduate
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A vehicle jumps at full speed over four cars, which explode one after the other. It’s a matter of precision and timing for the Stunt Heroes. Also, up-and-coming stuntwoman Tina has to prove her skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Italian Coupes
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They are the embodiment of a sportscar, the coupes by Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati and Alfa Romeo are breathtaking and irrisistible. Created by the most famous designers in the world, every Italian sportscar is a piece of art.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Rallye Fun
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We show how to have a lot of fun on gravel roads in a Subaru WRX STI. Also: in the 1990s, Ford had a successful go at rally competitions with the Ford Escort RS Cosworth. And: the Volkswagen Polo WRC shows its 4x4 skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - All-Wheel Drive on station wagons
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Skoda Octavia, the Opel Insignia Country Tourer, the Subaru Outback, the Audi S4 allroad quattro and the Seat Leon x-perience want to be more than roomy family cars. Their offroad features show that it doesn't always have to be an SUV.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - International SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Great Britain
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Whether it’s Jaguar, Rolls Royce or Bentley, whether it’s Aston Martin or McLaren, whether it’s a luxury saloon, coupe or super sports car, these automotive creations from the UK combine tradition, luxury, performance and that unique British style.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jackie Chan plays a dual role as twins separated at birth who grow up and cross paths. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

Along the way, he meets a half-demon princess and uncovers a sinister plot behind his former lovers mysterious resurrection. Wielding the Sacred Demon-Slaying Sword, he battles evil and becomes the legendary Demon Queller Zhong Kui.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛擺脫前夫家暴陰影的Jas,與妹妹前往英國偏遠鄉村度假散心。不料,兩人在森林散步時遭遇惡棍Randy率領的一群地痞流氓,不僅飽受騷擾與威脅,妹妹更慘遭槍殺。悲憤交加的Jas化身冷血獵手,就地取材設下重..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After escaping her abusive ex-husband, Jas travels with her sister to the remote English countryside for a getaway. During a woodland walk, they encounter Randy and his gang, who harass them before killing her sister. Grief-stricken, Jas sets deadly traps in the storm-soaked forest and embarks on a bloody quest for revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工阿文被安排潛伏於東南亞的軍火商旗下,尋找其手中的一批軍火炸藥並將其銷毀。當他終於找到該批軍火後,卻遭到不明匪徒襲擊。為防止災難發生,阿文決定與他的特工搭檔阿瓊合力奪回軍火。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武術宗師梁坤為保護心愛的女人毅然退隱江湖,不料他的隱忍卻換來了愛人的慘死。意識到宿命避無可避,他重返武林,在丐幫幫主蘇燦的鼎力相助下,梁坤殺出一條血路,誓要向那些冷血仇敵討回血債。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gangs conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nations honour.

This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cult leader Yu Luo Sha slays four sect leaders. Zhuo Yi Hang confronts her but falls in love. When he marries another, her hair turns white, and she vows eternal vengeance.

epg.programme_title_tc: Live and Die in East LA
epg.programme_title_en: Live and Die in East LA

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「驅魔龍族」第四十一代傳人馬小玲與身份成謎的偵探況天佑因連環詭異案件狹路相逢。一個是以除魔為己任的驅魔傳人,一個是游走於黑暗邊緣的嗜血異類,兩人從互相猜忌到宿命聯手,共同對抗威脅城市的黑暗勢力,並逐步..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們與兩位泰國藝人Gun和Ticha一起展開旅程,探索香港繁華的城市生活和幽靜的郊區。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Embark on the journey with two Thai artistes, Gun and Ticha, as they navigate the bustling city life and discover the serene outskirts of Hong Kong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東州地區長期盤踞一支販毒集團。霹靂女子突擊隊隊員梅靜率領其他隊員成功攻入販毒集團的制毒基地,卻中了預先設下的埋伏,梅爸爸是犯罪集團內部的臥底身份亦隨之暴露。最後,梅靜與突擊隊員們經歷一輪激戰後,擊敗對..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商人Burks被一對走投無路的夫婦綁架,被迫踏上開往洛杉磯的亡命之旅。途中危機四伏,三人發現彼此隱藏著致命的秘密。一場原本以為簡單的綁架,卻演變成奪命的博弈,當中沒有人能按計劃全身而退!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kidnapped by a desperate couple, businessman Burks Hill is forced on a frantic journey to Los Angeles. As danger mounts, the three travellers discover that they each harbour deadly secrets. What began as a simple kidnapping spirals into a lethal game where no ones plan will survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.programme_title_tc: 混世四猴: 神猴歸來
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救世主靈明石猴曾賜予絕望女孩生存的希望,並許下守護終生的承諾。不料多年後,他與傲慢的三眼戰神展開一場毀天滅地的大戰,最終慘遭擊敗,金身碎裂墮入凡塵。失去神力的石猴,究竟能否重燃鬥志,打破命運枷鎖,再度..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「驅魔龍族」第四十一代傳人馬小玲與身份成謎的偵探況天佑因連環詭異案件狹路相逢。一個是以除魔為己任的驅魔傳人,一個是游走於黑暗邊緣的嗜血異類,兩人從互相猜忌到宿命聯手,共同對抗威脅城市的黑暗勢力,並逐步..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們與兩位泰國藝人Gun和Ticha一起展開旅程,探索香港繁華的城市生活和幽靜的郊區。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Embark on the journey with two Thai artistes, Gun and Ticha, as they navigate the bustling city life and discover the serene outskirts of Hong Kong.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

Years later, the surviving Chan Tai Wah and Low Mai reunite to expose the long-hidden mole and avenge their fallen comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名兇殺組探員深入密林調查一連串離奇命案,現場遺留的線索竟與流傳已久的「野獸」傳說不謀而合。隨著死亡人數不斷攀升,他們發現這些兇案竟與當地流傳已久的古老傳說有著詭異的關聯,一場潛伏於密林深處的恐怖真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two homicide detectives investigate a series of grisly murders deep in the forest, where disturbing evidence points to the legendary “Beast”. As the body count rises, they uncover a chilling link between the killings and an ancient local legend, while a terrifying truth hidden deep within the woods slowly comes to light.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and  his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天才拳擊手徐佳陽為了替父親還賭債在地下酒館打黑拳時被舉報,痛失奧運資格賽,隕落拳壇。十年後,鐵血教練陳麗月決要助她實現父親的遺願,重回拳壇找回昔日的自己。當拳擊的熱血碰上責任時,曾經失落的拳擊夢能否再..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述清末上海的小人物陳真,在經歷苦難及面對無數挑戰後,蛻變成長為民族英雄的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地下拳手林楓因拒絕替曼谷黑幫打黑拳,因此被追殺。他雖成功逃脫,卻失去記憶。當林楓開展其新生活時,卻被黑幫發現行蹤,並找來絕頂打手對付他。期間林楓忽然回復記憶,並誓要將黑幫殲滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地下拳手林楓因拒絕替曼谷黑幫打黑拳,因此被追殺。他雖成功逃脫,卻失去記憶。當林楓開展其新生活時,卻被黑幫發現行蹤,並找來絕頂打手對付他。期間林楓忽然回復記憶,並誓要將黑幫殲滅。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名兇殺組探員深入密林調查一連串離奇命案,現場遺留的線索竟與流傳已久的「野獸」傳說不謀而合。隨著死亡人數不斷攀升,他們發現這些兇案竟與當地流傳已久的古老傳說有著詭異的關聯,一場潛伏於密林深處的恐怖真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two homicide detectives investigate a series of grisly murders deep in the forest, where disturbing evidence points to the legendary “Beast”. As the body count rises, they uncover a chilling link between the killings and an ancient local legend, while a terrifying truth hidden deep within the woods slowly comes to light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!在這一集中,菲律賓演員、模特和游泳選手Enchong Dee與名人好友Ria將在香港展開上山下海的旅程,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and  his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天才拳擊手徐佳陽為了替父親還賭債在地下酒館打黑拳時被舉報,痛失奧運資格賽,隕落拳壇。十年後,鐵血教練陳麗月決要助她實現父親的遺願,重回拳壇找回昔日的自己。當拳擊的熱血碰上責任時,曾經失落的拳擊夢能否再..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述清末上海的小人物陳真,在經歷苦難及面對無數挑戰後,蛻變成長為民族英雄的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After undergoing a secret government experiment, CIA operative Tara gains the ability to shapeshift into anyone through DNA transformation, making her the ultimate infiltrator. When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the world is plunged into eternal darkness, adventurer Xiao Wu sets out to find a sealed ancient book that controls the universe. Betrayed by ruthless factions, he discovers he is a reincarnated magical page bound by an ancient love. Awakening his hidden powers, he battles evil to restore light and fulfil his destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命之樹被燒毀後,世間陷入一片混沌。為拯救蒼生,孫悟空決定回到過去,幫助生命之樹復活。因為失去了金箍棒,孫悟空力量時有時無,只得找回兒時的自己,一同前往尋找時間之力。不料,六耳獼猴卻想據為己有,兩人就..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當天才駭客Tara試圖阻止一個擁有自我意識的強大人工智能接管全球軍事系統時,她反被人工智能定性為必須剷除的恐怖分子……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When expert hacker Tara tries to stop a powerful and sentient A.I. from taking over the worlds military, the A.I. marks her as a terrorist who must be exterminated…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三名持槍劫匪搶劫了一批正在運送的新發行貨幣,刑警常勇奉命展開調查。隨著線索逐漸浮現,常勇成功擊斃一名劫匪。然而,其他兩名劫匪不甘就此罷手,乘亂密謀搶劫金廠的黃金。常勇憑藉精密的部署,成功粉碎了他們的計..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.
