epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣.觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣.牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大.在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whales life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴哈馬被稱為水底電影世界的首都.荷里活已經到訪這裡幾十年了,在水晶般清澈的水底製作史詩式的電影和電視戲劇節目,其中的大熱景點包括許多電影般的沉船.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Bahamas is known as the underwater movie capital of the world. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters, leaving behind a host of cinematic shipwrecks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作.到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbirds funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crabs traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmons incredible uphill swimming skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力.目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾與豹同行,跟隨這些自然界的偽裝大師,隱沒於斯里蘭卡的叢林之中.深入了解這種強大的貓科獵手,如何完美適應島上炎熱乾燥的氣候,並學習牠們的追蹤和獵食技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潛入狹小緊迫的空間之中,鑽入溫室的底部結構,並進入緊張刺激的救援現場,捕蛇人勇敢面對一條長達六英尺,極度有毒的褐蛇.隨後觀看斯圖與莉芙將威脅到屋主寵物安全的沿海巨蟒小心搬遷至安全地點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into tight spaces, underneath hot houses, and into tense rescue situations as the catchers confront a six-foot-long, highly venomous brown snake. Then watch Stu and Liv relocate a coastal python threatening the safety of a homeowners pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈.觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​發現歐洲最佳建築如何為一些大陸上最稀有的物種創造庇護所.前往法國,蘇格蘭和西班牙,在那裡,海豹,鳥類,蠑螈,野貓和蛇類在水邊的古老地標之間茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how Europes best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continents rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在歐洲最壯觀的山峰之中見證動物的戲劇.造訪羅馬尼亞和法國的中世紀城堡,那裡的熊,猞猁和獵鷹正在復甦,然後看看在比利牛斯山中巧妙適應氣候變化的岩蜥蜴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness animal drama among Europes most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard thats cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where its mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘.它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But its not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. Its actually a divers paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的三大貓科動物:獅子,花豹和獵豹雖然並肩而居,但他們各自發展出專門的狩獵策略,以避免彼此衝突.深入了解這些頂級獵食者的生活和故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Though Africas three big cats-the lion, leopard, and cheetah-live side by side, each has evolved a specialised set of hunting strategies that keep them from colliding. Take an in-depth look at the lives and stories of these iconic apex predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​發現歐洲最佳建築如何為一些大陸上最稀有的物種創造庇護所.前往法國,蘇格蘭和西班牙,在那裡,海豹,鳥類,蠑螈,野貓和蛇類在水邊的古老地標之間茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how Europes best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continents rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在歐洲最壯觀的山峰之中見證動物的戲劇.造訪羅馬尼亞和法國的中世紀城堡,那裡的熊,猞猁和獵鷹正在復甦,然後看看在比利牛斯山中巧妙適應氣候變化的岩蜥蜴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness animal drama among Europes most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard thats cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where its mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘.它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But its not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. Its actually a divers paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈.觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​發現歐洲最佳建築如何為一些大陸上最稀有的物種創造庇護所.前往法國,蘇格蘭和西班牙,在那裡,海豹,鳥類,蠑螈,野貓和蛇類在水邊的古老地標之間茁壯成長.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅.觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 贊比亞的幼崽由成長至生育,皆面臨著巨大挑戰,每個教訓都意味著生死一線.牠們成年的過程需要技巧,力量,勇氣和大量的運氣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along t...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索美麗的海德堡城堡,它的廢墟屹立在德國西部的內卡河旁.這座城堡位於受保護的自然保育區中,是猛禽的家園,亦是附近兩棲類的產卵場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往擁有數百年歷史的法國堡壘,它是史上一些最偉大帝國的家園.卡爾卡松曾是財富和文化的中心,如今已成為野生動物的避難所.鳥類,野豬和昆蟲大軍在其豐裕的環境中生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of historys greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 發掘刻在洞穴裡世上最大的城堡.斯洛文尼亞的洞窟城堡不僅為中世紀的人類居民提供了保護,而且還為該區的鳥類,野豬和野山羊提供了避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the worlds largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊覽西班牙格林納達地區一生必到的非凡堡壘- 阿爾罕布拉宮.這個世界文化遺產現在成了該地區野生動植物的庇護所.它擁有眾多溪流和噴泉,可供應兩棲類,魚類和鳥類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spains Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the regions wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解世上最壯觀的建築之一 - 新天鵝堡及其周邊的森林如何成為許多生物的家園.從阿爾卑斯羱羊到雄偉的天鵝,這座城堡於數世紀以來成了天然避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how one of the worlds most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries.

epg.programme_title_tc: 美國野生邊界:北部揭祕 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著美加之間最長的邊境,野生動物猶如同時活在兩個世界.動物在障礙和矛盾的規則間如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地獄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵.觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its preys heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗.見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the oceans vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息.觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣.牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大.在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whales life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where its mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進.然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群.最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然間使河水滿溢的傾盆大雨帶來的歡喜.在獅子殺死獵豹的一隻幼崽後,為庫萊塔的喪子之痛而哀悼.並在野狗菲尼克斯與兇狠的獵狗對峙時觀看實時戰況.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuletas loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭,飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊.在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽. 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進.然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群.最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然間使河水滿溢的傾盆大雨帶來的歡喜.在獅子殺死獵豹的一隻幼崽後,為庫萊塔的喪子之痛而哀悼.並在野狗菲尼克斯與兇狠的獵狗對峙時觀看實時戰況.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuletas loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭,飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊.在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽. 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: SpongeBob's pet is Gary the Snail! Which cute pet has characteristics of both Gary and Mr. Krabs? In addition to that, there are many little-known secrets of them waiting for you to explore!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Early morning at the Brash household and Dr. Matt and his wife Clare, a horse vet, with their children enjoy a traditional English breakfast - on a traditional Dales day. They're off to the Malton Show. It's been an annual event for over a century, a chance for local people to meet and compete for prizes with their finest produce.  In a rural community, vets are crucial. Matt started as a farm vet before specialising in exotic animals. The show also gives him an opportunity to keep in touch with livestock.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. Parrots have a long lifespan and their IQ is comparable to that of a five-year-old child. How do you make them behave? Training is actually a good way, but how? "Melon seeds" are key to the goal. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss “Cute Pet Guide”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. Its time for Judys beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. Its time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩托車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食、果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫.他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐、與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球、打棒球、享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampas Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德里格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊、體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園、品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 占美跟卡卡杜的風景打卡;他與原住民梅曼迪聊天,他帶著占美沿著黃水河游船河飽覽她的國家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy checks out the landscapes of Kakadu; he chats with traditional owner Mandy Muir who takes Jimmy to see her country on a boat trip along the Yellow Waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 占美在帕華普週末市集的檔攤品嚐達爾文的流行街頭小食;並討論達爾文對叻沙的迷戀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy gets a taste of Darwins popular street food from the stalls of the Parap Saturday market; Jimmy discusses Darwins laksa obsession.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開.他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程.Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bens food journey starts in the West Coast of the South Island. He meets the only NZ cranberry producer at a farm in Hokitika and travels to Blackball to learn how chorizo is made. He cooks a range of dishes at the beach incorporating these local de

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到坎特伯里的高峰牧場,了解這座高地農場「從產地到餐桌」的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事.接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦——他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben visits High Peak Station in Canterbury and learns of their high -country farm to fork experience and tales of multigenerational stewardship. On the wild Tora Coast he meets a couple who harvest kaimoana sustainably – launching their fishing boat

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到黑斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉.他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bens travels to Hastings and discovers a holistic fully vertically integrated approach to creating grass fed Angus beef. He ventures to the local farmers market and meets amazing local food producers, reinforcing the abundance of produce grown in th

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家.他們共同的願景是製作天然、以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術.他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bens meets an Orchardist and Food Innovation specialist. They have a shared vision to make all natural varietal – led apple juice, using the best technology in the world. He also checks out over 30 varieties of figs grown in the Mediterranean type c

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處.他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調.他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben takes a boat to visit a salmon farm in Akaroa and learns the difference between NZ King and Atlantic salmon. He catches salmon and cooks it on the shoreline overlooking the harbour. He checks out a high-quality homegrown culinary oil thats both

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長、與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名.他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community. He discovers an all-electric cherry farm where premium export cherries are sold dire

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史.他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben experiences the Ruapehus region emerging food story and rich history of market gardening. He meets a sixth generation farmer who has turned a remote wilderness into a thriving eco-tourism and fine dining destination, alongside an award winning c

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾倫從愛丁堡出發,探索一列奢華列車,與列車主廚會面,造訪二戰與雅各賓紀念地,漫步於莫拉的銀白沙灘,並了解西高地鐵路的工程奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan explores a luxury train from Edinburgh, meets its chef, visits WWII and Jacobite memorials, strolls Morars Silver Sands, and learns about the West Highland Lines engineering marvels.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾倫在列車上享受水療設施,造訪威姆斯灣,參觀布特島上的斯圖亞特山莊,欣賞珍貴的莎士比亞原稿,探索列車工作人員區域,參與刺激冒險,並造訪皮特洛赫里的著名山頂劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan enjoys the trains spa, visits Wemyss Bay, tours Mount Stuart on Bute, sees a rare Shakespeare folio, explores crew areas, joins wild adventures, and tours Pitlochrys famed hilltop theatre.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾倫的奢華列車之旅持續展開,欣賞車廂美景,了解卡洛登的歷史,在普洛克頓觀察海豹,聆聽牧牛故事,體驗駕駛列車,品嚐威士忌,觀察老鷹,並在鄉間享受瑜伽的寧靜時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alans luxury train tour continues with cabin views, Cullodens history, seal-spotting in Plockton, cattle droving tales, train driving, whisky tasting, eagle spotting, and countryside yoga bliss.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習游泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物——沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 討人喜歡、被視為「滑稽」的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂.長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖.少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The endearing, comical puffin is Icelands national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imires anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成、新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the communitys role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. Its time for Judys beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. Its time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. Its time for Judys beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. Its time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚.當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called bubble feeding to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理查德・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將「旋轉圍捕」技巧適應於當地環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習游泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物——沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 討人喜歡、被視為「滑稽」的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂.長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖.少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The endearing, comical puffin is Icelands national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆.艾利斯——這位年輕執行長是「相對論太空公司」的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Tim Ellis. A young CEO, Tim is the founder of Relativity Space, the company that built and launched the worlds first 3D printed rocket.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德獲得前所未有的機會,進入全球最神祕的藝術作品之一——詹姆斯.特瑞爾的〈羅登火山口〉.在這座火山口中,藝術以光與宇宙為題展開探索.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard are given unprecedented access to one of the worlds most guarded artworks: James Turrells Roden Crater. Inside the volcanic crater, the art explores the use of light and the cosmos.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omars FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, hell create a boot inspired by ARCH.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆.艾利斯——這位年輕執行長是「相對論太空公司」的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 討人喜歡、被視為「滑稽」的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂.長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖.少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩托車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食、果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫.他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐、與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球、打棒球、享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampas Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德里格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊、體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園、品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.programme_title_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格:為行動而生
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從塔爾(Thal)的平凡起點,到成為好萊塢最響亮的名字之一.他以健美運動員出身,隨後轉戰演藝界與政壇,這就是傳奇動作巨星阿諾·史瓦辛格(Arnold Schwarzenegger)的一生與諸多考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings in Thal to becoming one of the biggest names in Hollywood. He began as a  bodybuilder, he turned to acting and politics, this is the life and many trials of the legendary action star, Arnold Schwarzenegger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the story of Shakira, the Columbian born superstar who has sold over 100 million records; covering her unwavering advocacy and philanthropic efforts that make her a role model for aspiring artists and fans alike.

epg.programme_title_tc: 惠妮休斯頓: 天籟背後
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描繪惠妮.休斯頓如流星般崛起的人生——從福音音樂的根源到全球巨星的巔峰,揭開錯綜複雜的情感關係、與成癮搏鬥的陰影,以及那把曾無可動搖、最終令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A powerful journey into the meteoric rise of Whitney Houston — from her gospel roots to global superstardom — unraveling the tangled relationships, haunting battles with addiction, and the heartbreaking fall of a once-unshakable voice, before her unt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果文化並非人類所獨有呢?科學家解密了各式各樣的行為,揭示文化在動物生活與物種生存中如何扮演至關重要的角色.邀請您一同加入這部在全體規模上首次紀錄動物文化的系列節目.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if culture was not limited to humans? A wide range of behaviors being deciphered reveals how culture plays a vital role in the life of animals and in the species survival. Join us in the first series documenting animal culture on a global scale.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態.從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugals diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾倫的奢華列車之旅持續展開,欣賞車廂美景,了解卡洛登的歷史,在普洛克頓觀察海豹,聆聽牧牛故事,體驗駕駛列車,品嚐威士忌,觀察老鷹,並在鄉間享受瑜伽的寧靜時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alans luxury train tour continues with cabin views, Cullodens history, seal-spotting in Plockton, cattle droving tales, train driving, whisky tasting, eagle spotting, and countryside yoga bliss.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alans rare journey sails to Iona and Staffa, tours Scone Palace and VA Dundee, reunites with a Broadway friend, savours Oban seafood, and ends with a ceilidh and farewell over the Forth Bridge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險、叢林健行、極致享受的巧克力按摩、蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Saint Lucia, the twins crash Maisies getaway for a whirlwind of sailing adventures, jungle hikes, decadent chocolate massages, rum tastings, and endless tropical fun!

epg.programme_title_tc: 惠妮休斯頓: 天籟背後
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描繪惠妮.休斯頓如流星般崛起的人生——從福音音樂的根源到全球巨星的巔峰,揭開錯綜複雜的情感關係、與成癮搏鬥的陰影,以及那把曾無可動搖、最終令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A powerful journey into the meteoric rise of Whitney Houston — from her gospel roots to global superstardom — unraveling the tangled relationships, haunting battles with addiction, and the heartbreaking fall of a once-unshakable voice, before her unt

epg.programme_title_tc: 揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋
epg.programme_title_en: Barbie Uncovered: A Dream House Divided
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋》揭示創作芭比娃娃背後的戲劇性真實故事,重點講述聯合創作者羅絲韓德勒和傑克瑞恩的高山與低谷,以及他們標誌性又備受爭議發明的持久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie Uncovered reveals the dramatic true story behind Barbies creation, spotlighting the rise and fallout of co-creators Ruth Handler and Jack Ryan, and the lasting impact of their iconic, controversial invention.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoos bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, Its a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客、一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. Theres room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoos bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, Its a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態.從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugals diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海.探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs spring rituals, and Grebes dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統.在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugals coastal waters and the Azores archipelago boast rich ecosystems. Explore the diverse species living in these waters and discover their unique lives in this revealing episode.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險、叢林健行、極致享受的巧克力按摩、蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Saint Lucia, the twins crash Maisies getaway for a whirlwind of sailing adventures, jungle hikes, decadent chocolate massages, rum tastings, and endless tropical fun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險——賞鯨、火山健行、策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland, Bonnie teams up with the twins for an epic escape—whale watching, volcano trekking, horseback riding, and inspiring eco chats under the midnight sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑戰腎上腺素極限:潛水探險、水上飛行器、揮桿高爾夫、快艇狂飆——最後邊晚餐邊暢聊《哈利波特》回憶,輸家買單!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Dubai, Luke goes all out with adrenaline-packed dives, jetpacking thrills, golf swings, and speedboat races—then shares Potter memories over dinner…the loser picks up the tab!

epg.programme_title_tc: 揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋
epg.programme_title_en: Barbie Uncovered: A Dream House Divided
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋》揭示創作芭比娃娃背後的戲劇性真實故事,重點講述聯合創作者羅絲韓德勒和傑克瑞恩的高山與低谷,以及他們標誌性又備受爭議發明的持久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie Uncovered reveals the dramatic true story behind Barbies creation, spotlighting the rise and fallout of co-creators Ruth Handler and Jack Ryan, and the lasting impact of their iconic, controversial invention.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索年輕的諾瑪珍.在展現才華和膽色的同時,她拋開艱辛的童年,以「瑪麗蓮夢露」的身份進入荷里活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the young Norma Jeane. While showing talent and audacity, she turned her back on her difficult childhood and put herself on the radar in Hollywood as Marilyn Monroe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 業餘賽車手蕭詠詩 (Vivian Siu) 夢想征戰澳門格蘭披治大賽.她自費且經驗極少,迅速躍升至 F4,成為中國錦標賽首位女車手.她面臨著技術和籌集關鍵資金的巨大挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amateur driver Vivian Siu chases her dream of racing the Macau Grand Prix. Self-funded and with minimal experience, she quickly jumps to Formula 4, becoming the first female driver in the Chinese Championship. She faces the huge challenge of driving

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳門大賽從賽程中移除,Vivian 的賽車之旅遭遇挫折,夢想面臨終結.即使有一絲希望,她仍需在數週內完成尋找賽車、車隊和搭檔車手的艱鉅任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vivians journey hits a roadblock when the Macau Grand Prix is removed from the calendar, threatening to end her dream. Even with a small chance of hope, she faces the immense task of securing a car, a team, and a co-driver in mere weeks.

epg.programme_title_tc: ABBA樂團:歐洲歌唱大賽後的半世紀
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從頭記錄ABBA由歐洲歌唱大賽到崛起成全球巨星、他們標誌性的嗓音、破紀錄的成功、單飛的努力、ABBA精選唱片- Gold的復甦,以及先進的全息投影巡演- 《啟航》,樂隊以虛擬形式重聚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chronicling ABBAs rise from Eurovision to global stardom, their iconic sound, record-breaking success, solo endeavors, ABBA Gold revival, and cutting-edge hologram tour Voyage that reunited the virtual band.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭比娃娃在2024年慶祝65歲生日.但她不僅是一塊12英寸長的塑膠或一個玩具. 這位傳奇金髮美女已成為一種現象和小孩們的寵兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie celebrates her 65th birthday in 2024. But she is way more than just a 12-inches long piece of plastic and way more than a toy. The legendary blond bombshell has grown into a phenomenon and a childrens sensation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生》是一部紀錄片,追隨這位演員從溫哥華到荷里活的崛起,探索他的喜劇發展、個人生活、心理健康、慈善事業和社交媒體掌控力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ryan Reynolds: Funny Business is a documentary tracing the actors rise from Vancouver to Hollywood, exploring his comedic evolution, personal life, mental health, philanthropy, and social media mastery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從百老匯舞台到好萊塢巨片,休·傑克曼(Hugh Jackman)是他那代最具才華、最全能的表演者之一.這部紀錄片追溯了他從澳洲的平凡起點,到憑藉「金鋼狼」一角名揚全球的星路歷程.透過舞台上的輝煌成就與個人的重重挑戰,我們將揭開這些角色背後,那位全心投入的演員、歌手以及人道主義者的真實面貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Broadway to blockbuster, Hugh Jackman is one of the most versatile performers of his generation. This documentary traces his journey from humble Australian beginnings to global stardom as Wolverine. Through stage triumphs and personal challenges

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探討瑪麗蓮如何反對裸體,以及她怎樣一躍成星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyns defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyns determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一趟視覺震撼的俯瞰之旅,帶您橫跨非洲、澳洲與斯堪地那維亞三大絕美勝地.全程採用 4K 攝影機精細捕捉,精緻刻畫出廣袤多元的壯麗地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A visually stunning aerial journey following three great destinations - Africa, Australia and Scandinavia. Beautifully filmed with a series of 4K cameras over the length and breadth of diverse landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索舉世聞名且保存完好的生物群落,親眼見證標誌性的特有物種——金剛鸚鵡、蜂鳥、安地斯神鷹以及海鬣蜥.這些經過數百萬年演化形成的物種,如今正面臨著森林砍伐與氣候變遷帶來的日益嚴峻之威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover world-renowned, well-preserved biotopes and meet iconic endemic species—macaws, hummingbirds, condors, and marine iguanas. Formed millions of years ago, these species now face growing threats from deforestation and climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索舉世聞名且保存完好的生物群落,親眼見證標誌性的特有物種——金剛鸚鵡、蜂鳥、安地斯神鷹以及海鬣蜥.這些經過數百萬年演化形成的物種,如今正面臨著森林砍伐與氣候變遷帶來的日益嚴峻之威脅.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復.我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程.透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, litt

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Dubai, Luke goes all out with adrenaline-packed dives, jetpacking thrills, golf swings, and speedboat races—then shares Potter memories over dinner…the loser picks up the tab!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激:征服壯麗塔特拉山、漂流急湍河道、探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Poland, Sophie trades a calm weekend for a rush of adventure: trekking the towering Tatras, rafting wild rivers, uncovering a legendary salt mine, and so much more!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在因斯布魯克,雙胞胎帶海莉闖入阿爾卑斯仙境,飛馳滑雪、雪車衝刺、盡情暢飲,重溫童星榮耀時刻——還有神秘魔法驚喜!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Innsbruck, the twins whisk Haley to an alpine wonderland of skiing, bobsledding, après-ski drinks, and a magical trip down childhood stardom—plus a touch of witchcraft!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison dêtre. The police forces special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000台風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計、生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩托車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食、果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫.他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐、與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球、打棒球、享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampas Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德里格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊、體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園、品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造、征服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營、回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴、跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝里斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址、走訪水洞、了解門諾會文化、巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食、飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyns determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how Marilyn shows her mature talent as an actress and wins a triumphant victory over Twentieth Century Fox shortly before her untimely death.

epg.programme_title_en: Keanu Reeves: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月、多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoos bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, Its a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在因斯布魯克,雙胞胎帶海莉闖入阿爾卑斯仙境,飛馳滑雪、雪車衝刺、盡情暢飲,重溫童星榮耀時刻——還有神秘魔法驚喜!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Innsbruck, the twins whisk Haley to an alpine wonderland of skiing, bobsledding, après-ski drinks, and a magical trip down childhood stardom—plus a touch of witchcraft!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決、傳統舞蹈、《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ireland, the twins join Evanna and her family for hurling matches, traditional dance, Potter nostalgia, and a spine-tingling countryside adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣.在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽、池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明與漁民們一起出海,抓捕到所謂的「百萬金槍」.他還遇到一位在2011年海嘯中救了他員工的豉油製造商.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計、生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客、一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. Theres room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆.艾利斯——這位年輕執行長是「相對論太空公司」的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Tim Ellis. A young CEO, Tim is the founder of Relativity Space, the company that built and launched the worlds first 3D printed rocket.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德獲得前所未有的機會,進入全球最神祕的藝術作品之一——詹姆斯.特瑞爾的〈羅登火山口〉.在這座火山口中,藝術以光與宇宙為題展開探索.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard are given unprecedented access to one of the worlds most guarded artworks: James Turrells Roden Crater. Inside the volcanic crater, the art explores the use of light and the cosmos.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omars FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, hell create a boot inspired by ARCH.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾.阿克拉波維奇——一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師.隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard travel to Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Igors company is an exhaust engineer known by MotoGP legends. As they learn from Igor, Arch will collaborate with him on a new project.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬.布拉德利——她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達.透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德里格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.programme_title_en: Keanu Reeves: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月、多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

epg.programme_title_tc: 摩根費里曼:不可思議的生涯
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入探索摩根・費里曼的人生旅程——從奮鬥與逆境,到塑造好萊塢的傳奇地位與獨一無二的標誌性嗓音.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey through the life of Morgan Freeman—his struggles, triumphs, and legendary voice that shaped Hollywood and beyond.

epg.programme_title_en: Celine Dion: The Heart Goes On
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳.狄翁是家喻戶曉的名字,象徵著無與倫比的音樂才華.然而,她的人生並非一帆風順.跟隨我們一同揭開傳奇背後的故事——從聲名鵲起的爆紅之路,到塑造她非凡事業的個人考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celine Dion is a household name, synonymous with musical brilliance. Yet, her life has not been untouched by hardship. Join us as we uncover the story behind the legend, her meteoric rise to fame, and the personal trials that shaped her remarkable ca

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omars FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, hell create a boot inspired by ARCH.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆.艾利斯——這位年輕執行長是「相對論太空公司」的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Tim Ellis. A young CEO, Tim is the founder of Relativity Space, the company that built and launched the worlds first 3D printed rocket.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德獲得前所未有的機會,進入全球最神祕的藝術作品之一——詹姆斯.特瑞爾的〈羅登火山口〉.在這座火山口中,藝術以光與宇宙為題展開探索.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard are given unprecedented access to one of the worlds most guarded artworks: James Turrells Roden Crater. Inside the volcanic crater, the art explores the use of light and the cosmos.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3

epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造、征服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營、回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴、跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝里斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址、走訪水洞、了解門諾會文化、巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食、飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alans rare journey sails to Iona and Staffa, tours Scone Palace and VA Dundee, reunites with a Broadway friend, savours Oban seafood, and ends with a ceilidh and farewell over the Forth Bridge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險、叢林健行、極致享受的巧克力按摩、蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Saint Lucia, the twins crash Maisies getaway for a whirlwind of sailing adventures, jungle hikes, decadent chocolate massages, rum tastings, and endless tropical fun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險——賞鯨、火山健行、策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland, Bonnie teams up with the twins for an epic escape—whale watching, volcano trekking, horseback riding, and inspiring eco chats under the midnight sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑戰腎上腺素極限:潛水探險、水上飛行器、揮桿高爾夫、快艇狂飆——最後邊晚餐邊暢聊《哈利波特》回憶,輸家買單!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Dubai, Luke goes all out with adrenaline-packed dives, jetpacking thrills, golf swings, and speedboat races—then shares Potter memories over dinner…the loser picks up the tab!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激:征服壯麗塔特拉山、漂流急湍河道、探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Poland, Sophie trades a calm weekend for a rush of adventure: trekking the towering Tatras, rafting wild rivers, uncovering a legendary salt mine, and so much more!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在因斯布魯克,雙胞胎帶海莉闖入阿爾卑斯仙境,飛馳滑雪、雪車衝刺、盡情暢飲,重溫童星榮耀時刻——還有神秘魔法驚喜!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Innsbruck, the twins whisk Haley to an alpine wonderland of skiing, bobsledding, après-ski drinks, and a magical trip down childhood stardom—plus a touch of witchcraft!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決、傳統舞蹈、《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ireland, the twins join Evanna and her family for hurling matches, traditional dance, Potter nostalgia, and a spine-tingling countryside adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣.在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽、池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明與漁民們一起出海,抓捕到所謂的「百萬金槍」.他還遇到一位在2011年海嘯中救了他員工的豉油製造商.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索舉世聞名且保存完好的生物群落,親眼見證標誌性的特有物種——金剛鸚鵡、蜂鳥、安地斯神鷹以及海鬣蜥.這些經過數百萬年演化形成的物種,如今正面臨著森林砍伐與氣候變遷帶來的日益嚴峻之威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover world-renowned, well-preserved biotopes and meet iconic endemic species—macaws, hummingbirds, condors, and marine iguanas. Formed millions of years ago, these species now face growing threats from deforestation and climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復.我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程.透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, litt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態.從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugals diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海.探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs spring rituals, and Grebes dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統.在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: No one could have dreamed that from this baby boy, born to a noble family on a financial and social decline, would grow one of China's most influential, iconic and important historical figures. Discover China follows in the footsteps of one of China's most important cultural heroes, Confucius.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma – it is a temple, dedicated to the god of Tai Mountain, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an imperial palace. The secrets behind this grand and lavish temple lie in a ceremonial farce, carried out by a brazen and ambitious emperor, who would not heed his country's desperate situation and instead tried to bolster his status as sole ruler. As time passed, and this emperor's remains turned to ashes, all that remains from this fantastic episode in China's history is this stunning shrine. Discover China uncovers the secrets of this temple and the ceremonies which brought it to life, in The Emperor's Fantasy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A startling scientific discovery has changed the face of evolutionary science. A single tooth shook the scientific community. The secrets the skulls of ancient ape-men, found in a Beijing suburb potentially held the key to the missing link in Human evolution. Dozens of experts formed an international team in an attempt to uncover the tracks of this specimen, and find out more about its habits. On the eve of war, these skulls suddenly disappeared off the face of the earth, leaving no trace. As the history unfolds, scientists debated the origin of the Peking ape-man, as the world wonders where his remains might be.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

networks.
